subject: My good friend, John Padora.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Padora for Colorado
body:
Hello, I’m Howard Chou, former Vice Chair of the Colorado Democratic Party. But more importantly I’m a concerned citizen who is worried for the future of America just like you.
__ | | | [](http://links.padoraforcongress.com/u/click?_t=1632d2fd715245289db23a5b99e588cb&_m=e89dbffed6944f1598835b7627c11e66&_e=TyJ5j3jckvr_IH-ls6qzM__vk1nDvhIGlfIG3QJ9Dx-vMBokiPGMvulxyw6l3R2FZnsUSOzPmM6EIb36S-5LDt8RKGl5UfqdrQGjUcyV01qPz_6RC2u5l8RyfP7UGoNnbX3i2f6fF2SVwZxdQ0WTgxz3Zh4gH4QJuET7IJczcy_YKyB8XuY1qQjqgHCX9Des4Y8sY449DBZca_RUVJ-WBy24fvkiIZYkOtcwcOn6sNmdlZ-jGhOZL0Mhk1NRGL4l1eRdNmDlUwC-9_lOTbmKJCeHR-AcZC3YZdzOyK4toAPQU2HB-S6F_aSj0JcSmLEUCVUp1yL11mrWQS7-S8PF5NZ8eLECzwnrtpGzxtT5gkpWcerMvyVH5qsmMHhTxZiEJ45leq0tKQJtvwUtp8mX4w%3D%3D) Hello, I’m Howard Chou, former Vice Chair of the Colorado Democratic Party. But more importantly I’m a concerned citizen who is worried for the future of America just like you. I’m reaching out to you because as I look for that future we can all thrive in, I only see one person that can lead us to a better tomorrow. One person that is selfless in his relentless pursuit to provide opportunity and equity for every American and committed to remove corruption from our government. That person is my good friend, John Padora. [](http://links.padoraforcongress.com/u/click?_t=1632d2fd715245289db23a5b99e588cb&_m=e89dbffed6944f1598835b7627c11e66&_e=TyJ5j3jckvr_IH-ls6qzM__vk1nDvhIGlfIG3QJ9Dx-vMBokiPGMvulxyw6l3R2FZnsUSOzPmM6EIb36S-5LDt8RKGl5UfqdrQGjUcyV01qPz_6RC2u5l8RyfP7UGoNnbX3i2f6fF2SVwZxdQ0WTgxz3Zh4gH4QJuET7IJczcy_YKyB8XuY1qQjqgHCX9Des4Y8sY449DBZca_RUVJ-WBy24fvkiIZYkOtcwcOn6sNmdlZ-jGhOZL0Mhk1NRGL4lY6WVfO2TbkNexEVqe3biCTA4cgMpT2kvdiNZdLB6HOwu3Q8-mhSXzNLeueFzSnafMYn5ayBXyIL3scelIRTMCoCzuA7SbsjUn4i7du8UwA-GRcR_u_MHBaBQbDzK6QLKDv0J78GM_42FwCyVN7bUeA%3D%3D) I believe in John because of his lived experiences and his ability to overcome personal hardships and suffering and then use that experience to fight for others. **[Before I tell you more, can he count on you to donate anything you can right here, right now?](http://links.padoraforcongress.com/u/click?_t=1632d2fd715245289db23a5b99e588cb&_m=e89dbffed6944f1598835b7627c11e66&_e=TyJ5j3jckvr_IH-ls6qzM__vk1nDvhIGlfIG3QJ9Dx-vMBokiPGMvulxyw6l3R2FZnsUSOzPmM6EIb36S-5LDt8RKGl5UfqdrQGjUcyV01qPz_6RC2u5l8RyfP7UGoNnbX3i2f6fF2SVwZxdQ0WTgxz3Zh4gH4QJuET7IJczcy_YKyB8XuY1qQjqgHCX9Des4Y8sY449DBZca_RUVJ-WBy24fvkiIZYkOtcwcOn6sNmdlZ-jGhOZL0Mhk1NRGL4ln-wM4AZ5sqO7gKZvIuQm6H-Cpgx2UQNmrj6mTZcfcTffYs6OL08rTBI4Kj7ZvYuvydoOwGNX0Rm_Zsut15oueEH3zlDgzgjlXnRMfpRB5lFr6GBKHq17sz2Lu4lgUOo3TUAmah56UT_Nc4aqLHNS-Q%3D%3D)** Look, I know firsthand the importance of fighting to defend the freedoms that we enjoy every day. **My family came to the United States through the sponsorship of my late grandmother, a refugee who was granted asylum in the US.** My grandfather was a soldier for the nationalist army who died fighting against communism in China and my grandmother had to flee to Taiwan by boat. However, her boat was boarded and she jumped into the ocean to avoid capture and was luckily rescued by the US Navy and brought to the US. There she was detained until she was given refugee status and eventually became a citizen to sponsor us. _**I know courage in the face of adversity when I see it and I know John possesses this quality.**_ John is dedicated to defending Women’s reproductive and abortion rights, protecting our environment, fighting for healthcare, expanding a national right to repair bill and providing equity for working families for all Coloradans. He believes in pushing for a national bill like our own state’s Reproductive Health Equity Act to protect women’s rights. He knows that we must hold corporations accountable for our orphan wells problem and provide safe air and water for all our residents. John understands that healthcare should never be a luxury as his father was struck with Multiple Sclerosis. He recognizes how important it is to help our majority of independent farmers succeed for the benefit of us all. **[Let’s fight back the extremism and incompetence of the likes of Boebert and others! Join me in supporting John Padora by contributing to this campaign so that we can fight for a better tomorrow for all of us.](http://links.padoraforcongress.com/u/click?_t=1632d2fd715245289db23a5b99e588cb&_m=e89dbffed6944f1598835b7627c11e66&_e=TyJ5j3jckvr_IH-ls6qzM__vk1nDvhIGlfIG3QJ9Dx-vMBokiPGMvulxyw6l3R2FZnsUSOzPmM6EIb36S-5LDt8RKGl5UfqdrQGjUcyV01qPz_6RC2u5l8RyfP7UGoNnbX3i2f6fF2SVwZxdQ0WTgxz3Zh4gH4QJuET7IJczcy_YKyB8XuY1qQjqgHCX9Des4Y8sY449DBZca_RUVJ-WBy24fvkiIZYkOtcwcOn6sNmdlZ-jGhOZL0Mhk1NRGL4lBxhga7lIdxU--Kjc_SFTIFJ9cNE8jnkooqQtbVGUAyYPNhgP1slYbeZuHdglvwErQuqBfEmrvpJEBx2aUKV89Iy5B5wYbfTCsuHysE0tvkA8jTAEE9Cv_Eabj1JNVqsAKyk0hLMcTGBa7Umw3YGRNQ%3D%3D)** John’s vision encompasses everything necessary for Coloradans to have the opportunity to achieve the American dream. I hope you’ll vote for him on June 25th. _Howard Chou_ I'm John Padora, a Democrat running for Congress in CD-04. Lauren Boebert recently jumped into my district in a desperate attempt to stay in DC. My campaign is powered by grassroots donations - donate anything you can monthly to keep Boebert OUT of this seat. God bless you!

During this dark time for America, we wanted to send you this letter to make sure you feel our love and support.

AND WE WILL NEVER ABANDON YOU.

Justice will be served. We will make sure of it.

God bless you President Trump, and God help America.

Sincerely,

{YOUR SIGNATURE}

Right now, polls are tightening and dark money groups are set to spend record breaking amounts to unseat me. If you don’t step up with a donation to help us fight back, we could lose this election.

# Melton for Iowa 2024
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week:
Last week, I attended the IDP Hall of Fame event up in Sioux Center, marched in a parade in Fort Dodge with the Webster County Democrats, spoke on a candidate panel regarding my advocacy for the LGBTQ+ community at Sioux City Pride, and attended a fundraiser in Council Bluffs for State Senate candidate Steve Gorman.
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: This week is primary week, and I'm proud to say that for the second time in a row, I will be the Democratic Party nominee for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District after winning the primary yesterday. I did have a primary opponent through the end of the year last year, but he dropped out, so I was unopposed on the ballot. It is an honor and a privilege to be in this position a second straight cycle, to amplify the voices of those that too often go unheard in our district, to speak truth to power that far too often goes unchecked, and to fight the good fight despite the odds.
I think what happened in the Republican primary shows we have a big opportunity to break through in November. In reference to Randy Feenstra's post last night that Iowans in the 4th "clearly" showed they support him, here was my response last night on my campaign socials:
"The only "clear message" from the Republican primary in IA-04 is a twice-elected incumbent got 40% of the vote and 9 counties taken away from him by a guy who got in to challenge him with no name recognition, no corporate PAC money, who got in the race really late.
Feenstra has no mandate and is a weak general election candidate who is still owned by eminent domain abuser Bruce Rastetter and the state's other corporate elites. His challenger Kevin Virgil and I disagree on plenty of things, but we do agree on the dangers of disproportionate corporate power in our governance and our politics, are robustly opposed to the carbon capture pipelines, don't bow down to the big monied bosses that run our parties, and actually acknowledge there's a cancer crisis in our state that urgently needs addressed.
I thank Kevin for fighting the good fight on those fronts, and I will continue to do so as well. Clearly, that vision is resonating with a lot of voters here in the 4th. Finally, it is an honor and a privilege to be the Democratic nominee in IA-04 a second straight time. I work a full time job and am raising two boys in addition to being the best husband I can be while campaigning. It's exhausting, but I am grateful I have your trust."
Our schedule for this week: On Monday 6/3, I attended a campaign kick off in Marshalltown for City Council candidate Melisa Fonseca. This weekend, I'll be marching at the Flagfest parade in Spencer with the Clay County Democrats Saturday 6/8, and will probably be disseminating my signs that just came in to counties throughout the district. If you want a sign, let me know, and I'll sync you up with your county's Melton sign distributor. I may also do some door knocking but I'd really like to get my signs out to my points of contact in each county asap so we can get our signs out there.
Recent press/social media posts of note: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6ybg__h4CpI
We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers
Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com!
Let's keep fighting the good fight together! Ryan Melton

Today we’re exactly five months away from Election Day – which may seem like a lot of time, but here’s what that actually means for practical purposes:

1. In many states, early and mail-in voting begins ahead of Election Day. Here in California, ballots begin being mailed in early October.
2. Voter outreach – educating, persuading, and turning out as many people as possible – has to start well before anyone actually receives a ballot.
3. That means we’re up against some critical windows of opportunity, like...now!

Fellow American,

After last night, all eyes are on our campaign. All eyes are on our race to take back our state from the Democrat monopoly that has dominated NJ politics for too long.

THEY SAID IT COULDN'T BE DONE, BUT WE DID IT!

They said we couldn't win this primary against the odds, but we did it, AND WE DID IT TOGETHER.

This was possible because of our campaign team, volunteers, and people like you who believed in this “sleeper race.”

I am so proud of what we accomplished last night. Instead of tearing people down, we are building something bigger. **We are building a bigger, better Republican Party together - a party of people who believe in greater freedom and more opportunities.**

I always take my cues from Montanans. = Whether he’s playing cowboy or pretending he grew up surrounded by farmland, Tim Sheehy is shamelessly lying when it’s clear he doesn’t understand a lick about what makes rural America so special. subject: Peter, I really need your help if we’re going to take back Arizona’s Senate seat

body:
When I was serving in the Marines, I never thought I’d be in this position. On patrol in Al Anbar, Iraq, I was about as far from Congress as you can get.
#
_* Sent in support of Ruben Gallego for Arizona and Lucas Kunce for Missouri *_
Peter —
I’ve got to be honest with you. I never thought this is how it’d go.
When I was sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never thought I’d be running for Senate someday. All I knew was that I was going to have to work my butt off to get into a good school — after that, I had no idea.
When I was serving in the Marines, I never thought I’d be in this position. On patrol in Al Anbar, Iraq, I was about as far from Congress as you can get.
Even today, I never thought hundreds of thousands of people would contribute and volunteer to help elect me.
And I never thought I’d need to ask supporters like you to do more than that to help me take back Arizona’s Senate seat.
But I need to ask you to do more. We’re facing the first major attacks of the race, a television buy of $10 million from Lake and the NRSC. The former president is attacking me directly. And we’ve missed a few fundraising goals already this year.
So, please... You probably didn’t wake up this morning thinking you’d make a donation to my campaign, but I really need you if we’re going to win in Arizona.

Fellow American,

After last night, all eyes are on our campaign. All eyes are on our race to take back our state from the Democrat monopoly that has dominated NJ politics for too long.

THEY SAID IT COULDN'T BE DONE, BUT WE DID IT!

They said we couldn't win this primary against the odds, but we did it, AND WE DID IT TOGETHER.

_**Thank you.**_
This was possible because of our campaign team, volunteers, and people like you who believed in this “sleeper race.”

I am so proud of what we accomplished last night. Instead of tearing people down, we are building something bigger. **We are building a bigger, better Republican Party together - a party of people who believe in greater freedom and more opportunities.**

This is just the beginning. _We are starting a movement right here in New Jersey._

Before I entered this race, they told me not to run and that it couldn't be done, but I don't believe that's true.

I believe in New Jersey, I believe in its people, and I believe in freedom. And that's why I believe it's time for change.

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

This is just the beginning. We are starting a movement right here in New Jersey. Before I entered this race, they told me not to run and that it couldn't be done, but I don't believe that's true. I believe in New Jersey, I believe in its people, and I believe in freedom. And that's why I believe it's time for change. I am a political outsider who can deliver results - I've done it before when people told me it couldn't be done. I dedicated the beginning of my career to restoring a New Jersey landmark, Congress Hall, when doubters told me I couldn't. They were wrong back then and will be wrong again this November. We can't keep sending the same old politicians to Washington and expecting the same unacceptable results. We can continue down the same old road, with the same entrenched DC politicians like Andy Kim and Bob Menendez, or we can go down a different path. Oh, and in case you didn't hear, I'm running not against not one but TWO machine Democrats this November. We will fight for this Senate seat and take back the Democratic monopoly, It's time to look to November. We must build a movement full of individuals who believe in common-sense solutions to real problems that Americans face. Your contribution today will help catapult our campaign into the official start of the general election. Thank you, Curtis Bashaw Republican Nominee, United States Senate | GET TO KNOW CURTIS Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans. A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York. Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities. Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will. | If you'd like to unsubscribe, please . | PAID FOR BY CURTIS BASHAW FOR US SENATE, INC.

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: ☀️ Fired up for an organizing summer / Estamos listos para un verano de organizando ☀️
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
#NewGridNow:
Join us for a Houston storm recovery town hall this Saturday
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Flyer%20Houston%20June%208%20storm%20recovery%20town%20hall.jpg]
HARRIS COUNTY RESIDENTS! We deserve a power grid that won’t fail in the next storm. The devastating impact of these recent Houston storms highlights the urgent need for comprehensive climate action and infrastructure reform. Climate change is not a distant threat; it’s here and now, and it’s hitting our working Black and Latino communities the hardest.
Join our Houston Community Resource Relief Townhall with allies on June 8th at Pleasant Hill Baptist Church at 12 p.m. as we come together after the storm to discuss community-driven solutions to climate change, and to make sure we can protect our families and neighbors before the next devastating storm hits.
RSVP for the Houston Community Resource Relief Townhall here. [https://secure.everyaction.com/CEmyE6ENTkuECpsESmhuZw2]
For more information, email Sofia Lopez at slopez@organizetexas.org [slopez@organizetexas.org] .
F
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Title%2042%20newsletter.jpg]
Playing politics with the lives of people seeking asylum is despicable and must never be normalized. No matter the color of your skin, the language you speak, or how much money you have to your name, seeking asylum is a fundamental human right.
President Biden's move to restrict asylum along our southern border not only violates international law, it endangers the lives of thousands of families in need of aid. [https://www.motherjones.com/politics/2024/06/biden-announces-new-border-crackdown-asylum-trump-ban/]
Implementing Trump-like anti-immigrant policies is unacceptable and a step backward for this administration. Any executive order should focus on enacting bold humanitarian solutions to ease tension along our southern border, not on adopting harmful, exclusionary policies.
TOP is proud to work with immigration justice allies in welcoming people seeking refuge in our communities and ensuring they have access to the resources they need to thrive. We do so while continuing to push for the common-sense, dignified immigration system that our country so desperately needs. Congress must act now to pass comprehensive immigration reform and permanent relief for DACA recipients, providing safety, stability, and security to millions of immigrants who call this country home.
Guilty on all 34 counts
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Trump%20X%20copy.jpg]
Justice is finally catching up to Donald Trump. [https://www.msnbc.com/the-beat-with-ari/watch/why-trump-may-lose-2024-he-s-a-convicted-felon-along-with-his-cfo-2016-chair-wh-aides-lawyers-212258373907] He can whine and gaslight the public all he wants, but the fact remains that Trump – a coup-plotting, twice-impeached racist who's racked up four criminal indictments – has rightfully been found guilty on 34 felony counts by a jury of his peers.
Meanwhile, here in Texas, MAGA loyalists Greg Abbott, Dan Patrick, Ken Paxton, and Ted Cruz, are taking to social media to deflect and provide political cover for a con man who attempted to overturn an election and who incited a horde of white supremacists to storm the U.S. Capitol.
No matter what we look like or where we come from, each and every one of us deserves elected leaders who will defend our democracy and fairly govern with integrity. Any official who lies to the American people, stokes violence and division, and refuses to take responsibility for the harm they cause is unfit to represent us.
While Trump’s self-inflicted legal woes continue, TOP will be in Black and Latino neighborhoods across Texas this fall, engaging with voters at their doorstep and countering his white nationalist MAGA agenda with a bold, transformative #TexasForAll vision where progressive, people-powered candidates uphold our rights and freedoms.
TOP Tips: Save our Pride Month playlist
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/pride_progress_intersex_inclusive_rainbow_flag.jpg]
As we celebrate Pride Month, TOP stands in solidarity with our LGBTQIA+ community, especially our Black and Latino, and non-binary brothers and sisters. This month is a time to honor the resilience, strength, and courage of those who have fought — and continue to fight — for justice and our collective liberation. It is also a reminder of the work that remains to be done in Texas. Check out TOP’s Pride Vibes playlist on Spotify. [https://open.spotify.com/playlist/1feXpOEhiWruZ5MushkBNh]
Español
#NewGridNow:
Asista a nuestra reunión pública sobre recuperación de tormentas en Houston este sábado
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Flyer%20Houston%20June%208%20storm%20recovery%20town%20hall.jpg]
¡RESIDENTES DEL CONDADO DE HARRIS! Merecemos una red eléctrica que no fallará en la próxima tormenta. El impacto devastador de estas recientes tormentas en Houston resalta la urgente necesidad de una acción climática integral y una reforma de la infraestructura. El cambio climático no es una amenaza lejana; está aquí y ahora, y está afectando más duramente a nuestras comunidades trabajadoras Negras y Latinas.
Únase a nuestra reunión pública de ayuda de recursos comunitarios de Houston con aliados el 8 de junio en la Iglesia Bautista Pleasant Hill a las 12 p.m. mientras nos reunimos después de la tormenta para discutir soluciones al cambio climático impulsadas por la comunidad y para asegurarnos de que podamos proteger a nuestras familias y vecinos antes de que llegue la próxima tormenta devastadora.
Confirme su asistencia al Ayuntamiento de Ayuda a los Recursos Comunitarios de Houston aquí. [click.everyaction.com/k/85884740/476202647/128488047]
Para obtener más información, envíe un correo electrónico a Sofia Lopez a slopez@organizetexas.org [slopez@organizetexas.org] .
Solicitar asilo es un derecho humano fundamental
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Title%2042%20newsletter.jpg]
Jugar a la política con las vidas de las personas que buscan asilo es despreciable y nunca debe normalizarse. No importa el color de su piel, el idioma que hable o cuánto dinero tenga a su nombre, solicitar asilo es un derecho humano fundamental.
La medida del presidente Biden de restringir el asilo a lo largo de nuestra frontera sur no sólo viola el derecho internacional, sino que pone en peligro las vidas de miles de familias que necesitan ayuda. [https://apnews.com/us-news/general-news-8a7a0a3e9f1c24a88554573148d152dc]
Implementar políticas anti-inmigrantes como las de Trump es inaceptable y un paso atrás para esta administración. Cualquier orden ejecutiva al respecto debería centrarse en implementar soluciones humanitarias valientes que alivien la tensión de nuestra frontera sur, no en adoptar leyes políticas perjudiciales y excluyentes.
TOP se enorgullece de trabajar con aliados de la justicia migratoria para dar la bienvenida a las personas que buscan refugio en nuestras comunidades y garantizar que tengan acceso a los recursos que necesitan para prosperar. Lo hacemos mientras continuamos presionando por un sistema de migración digno y con sentido común que nuestro país tan desesperadamente necesita. El Congreso debe actuar ahora para aprobar una reforma migratoria integral y un alivio permanente para los beneficiarios de DACA, brindando seguridad, estabilidad y protección a millones de inmigrantes que llaman a este país su hogar.
Culpable de 34 delitos graves
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Trump%20X%20copy.jpg]
La justicia finalmente está alcanzando a Donald Trump. [https://www.bbc.com/mundo/articles/c800673y0yro] Puede quejarse y criticar al público todo lo que quiera, pero el hecho es que Trump –un racista golpista, acusado dos veces de destitución y que ha acumulado cuatro acusaciones penales– ha sido declarado culpable de 34 delitos sumamente graves por un jurado.
Mientras tanto, aquí en Texas, los activistas de MAGA, Greg Abbott, Dan Patrick, Ken Paxton y Ted Cruz, están recurriendo a las redes sociales para desviar y brindar cobertura política a un estafador que intentó anular una elección y que incitó a una ola de supremacistas blancos a asaltar el Capitolio de los Estados Unidos.
No importa cómo nos veamos, de dónde venimos o por quién votemos, todos y cada uno de nosotros merecemos líderes electos que defiendan nuestra democracia y gobiernen de manera justa e íntegra. Cualquier funcionario que mienta al pueblo Estadounidense, avive la violencia y la división y se niegue a asumir la responsabilidad por el daño que causan no es apto de ser nuestro representante.
Mientras continúan los problemas legales autoinfligidos de Trump, TOP estará en los vecindarios Negros y Latinos de todo Texas este otoño, conectando con los votantes y luchando en contra de la agenda nacionalista blanca que es MAGA. Nuestra visión audaz y transformadora de #TexasForAll es una donde los candidatos progresistas, respaldados por la comunidad, resguardaran nuestros derechos y libertades.
Consejos de TOP: Escuche nuestra lista de reproducción del Mes del Orgullo
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/pride_progress_intersex_inclusive_rainbow_flag.jpg]
Mientras celebramos el Mes del Orgullo, TOP se solidariza con nuestra comunidad LGBTQIA+, especialmente con nuestros hermanos y hermanas negros, latinos y no binarios. Este mes es un momento para honrar la resiliencia, la fuerza y el coraje de quienes han luchado (y continúan luchando) por la justicia y la liberación colectiva. También es un recordatorio del trabajo que queda por hacer en Texas. Escuche la lista de reproducción Pride Vibes de TOP en Spotify. [https://open.spotify.com/playlist/1feXpOEhiWruZ5MushkBNh]

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: Our nation’s history is unifying
body:
Hillsdale College has been engaging the Left on the battlefield of education

Hillsdale College | | | This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z10nksr6339p8vm2h10cjcnjfecg6p1uhbn1dto0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdhm6oj6clh2bs) Fellow American, [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ztagr4f5pfn77iokc2n2kqpdu0p80narqf3qn9k0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdhm6oj6clh2bs) You may be discouraged by the Left’s dominance in our colleges and universities, and its increasing influence in K-12 education. But we must not lose hope. Instead, we must fight back with the truth. Hillsdale College has been engaging the Left on the battlefield of education from the beginning. That’s why we’ve turned our course, [**“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zjbnuvjpissuf8miurkh7251mpdj2ndf6j8mntlo_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdhm6oj6clh2bs) into a DVD set, and I’d like you to have a copy. Taught by historian Wilfred McClay and based on his recently published history of America, **“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”** presents a full, unbiased account of America’s past. Hillsdale’s goal in producing this course is to **restore the kind of intelligent patriotism—especially among our young people—that is essential to preserving free government.** **“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”** is a powerful counterweight to _The New York Times’_ “1619 Project,” which is injecting the idea that America is an essentially unjust nation into the curricula of America’s K-12 schools. name: Huffines Liberty Foundation
subject: HLF at RPT State Convention!
body:
The entire Huffines Liberty Foundation team loved connecting with so many like-minded advocates for liberty at the 2024 Republican Party of Texas State Convention.
No images? [Click here](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-e-ehrhhty-yuddtktydi-q/) [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrhhty-yuddtktydi-r/) **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Press Manager
Contact: [Press@HuffinesLiberty.com](mailto:Press@HuffinesLiberty.com)
## **Huffines Liberty Foundation at the Republican Party of Texas State Convention**
The entire Huffines Liberty Foundation team loved connecting with so many like-minded advocates for liberty at the 2024 Republican Party of Texas State Convention.At our Huffines Liberty Foundation booth, we passed out t-shirts, hats, koozies, and other swag. Most importantly, we educated Texans on the solutions to the most pressing issues facing our great State: eliminating the school M&O property tax and securing the Texas Border. At HLF, we strive to solve the problem, not the symptoms of the problem. For those who could not attend the RPT Convention, go to **[HuffinesLiberty.com](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrhhty-yuddtktydi-y/)** to read our researched solutions.
## **Don Huffines' Speech at the 2024 RPT Convention**
[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrhhty-yuddtktydi-j/) Don Huffines, president of the Huffines Liberty Foundation, gave a speech at the 2024 Republican Party of Texas State Convention in San Antonio. [Watch Don Huffines' Speech](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrhhty-yuddtktydi-t/)
## **Texas GOP Delegates Vote to Close Primaries**
[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrhhty-yuddtktydi-i/) Following a report from HLF on how implementing closed primaries is a straightforward application of the Republican Party of Texas' First Amendment rights of association, RPT delegates adopted Rule 46, which closes the Republican Primary in Texas.Legal precedents in Texas, other states, and the U.S. Supreme Court provide a path to defend this new Rule 46 in court.This new rule lays the groundwork for RPT Delegates to implement term limits as a party Rule. Term limits are yet another example of how political parties can exercise their freedom of association under the First Amendment to the U.S. Constitution. Courts have consistently upheld this right of political parties. [Read Full Report on Term Limits & Closed Primaries](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrhhty-yuddtktydi-h/)
## **HLF Solutions Video**
[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrhhty-yuddtktydi-k/) At Convention, we unveiled a new video from the Huffines Liberty Foundation outlining our priorities going forward. To best educate Texas citizens, so you can hold their elected officials accountable, we look beyond the obvious and develop researched solutions to the greatest problems facing Texas:
* Economic Pressure on Mexico
* Eliminate School Property Taxes
* Pass Education Freedom
* Ban Taxpayer-Funded Lobbying
* Mandate E-Verify
* Expose Government Corruption
* Demand Honest, Transparent Budgets

Few organizations have done more to change the narrative in Texas than the Huffines Liberty Foundation, working to make Texas a lighthouse for liberty for generations to come. If we lose Texas, we lose the free world. And HLF will be here, in the fight, working to educate and equip you all to advance liberty! [Watch Our 60 Second Video](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrhhty-yuddtktydi-u/) The Huffines Liberty Foundation is a 501(c)(3) non-profit, non-partisan research institute. Our mission is to advance the cause of **liberty** , **prosperity** , and **virtue** in the State of Texas by educating and equipping citizens so they may hold their elected officials accountable and better informed to tackle the toughest challenges.###
### _Help us advance liberty, prosperity, and virtue in Texas:_
[Donate](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrhhty-yuddtktydi-o/) [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrhhty-yuddtktydi-b/)[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrhhty-yuddtktydi-n/)[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrhhty-yuddtktydi-p/) | [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrhhty-yuddtktydi-x/) | [ Share ](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-fb-ehrhhty-yuddtktydi-e/) | [ Tweet ](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-tw-ehrhhty-yuddtktydi-s/) | [ Forward ](https://huffineslibertyfoundation.forwardtomyfriend.com/t-yuddtktydi-17329976-ehrhhty-l-g)

Hey Friend, I'm not sure if you've seen this, but I just had to show you.

**House Republicans are sending my father this[BEAUTIFUL letter](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z78gldloa8am5uj6jv37u8u5p3etafsu196abtto_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdjm8or4clh2bs "BEAUTIFUL letter") to show their support and gratitude for him through these dark, unprecedented times. Take a look for yourself:**

---

Americans from across the country have signed the letter, and it's an overwhelming show of solidarity. It's incredible to see so many Patriots taking a stand with my father during these dark times.

**[Would you sign the letter, too?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zsbsnbqesvd0al4jtr2mse40o0nvi6bu8trt71ro_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdjm8or4clh2bs "Would you sign the letter, too?") **It would be so meaningful to have a massive number of strong, America First Conservatives sign their names to send my father some joy and positivity.

I am personally so grateful to see the remarkable number of patriots who proudly stand with my father.

**[Please join me in signing this big, beautiful letter to express your support and gratitude to my father, President Donald J. Trump.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5jdpccvp4df0mrh3a5bge45agmfa3et8vos3goo_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdjm8or4clh2bs "Please join me in signing this big, beautiful letter to express your support and gratitude to my father, President Donald J. Thank you for standing with me and our fellow Patriots in the face of recent adversity.

God Bless,

Donald Trump Jr.

body:
Hillsdale College has been engaging the Left on the battlefield of education

Hillsdale College | | | This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zo31dt3kavvs152u850mq5ne5lpc21k1un3mh0k0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdjm8or2chh2bs) Fellow American, [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zbc1dn5rc55jcdlph1444sg1na5t5fcfou623gm0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdjm8or2chh2bs) You may be discouraged by the Left’s dominance in our colleges and universities, and its increasing influence in K-12 education. But we must not lose hope. Instead, we must fight back with the truth. Hillsdale College has been engaging the Left on the battlefield of education from the beginning. That’s why we’ve turned our course, [**“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2znnu03g156bvijc68pj7pas07lvk5e7ngmehhdqg_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdjm8or2chh2bs) into a DVD set, and I’d like you to have a copy. Taught by historian Wilfred McClay and based on his recently published history of America, **“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”** presents a full, unbiased account of America’s past. Hillsdale’s goal in producing this course is to **restore the kind of intelligent patriotism—especially among our young people—that is essential to preserving free government.** **“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”** is a powerful counterweight to _The New York Times’_ “1619 Project,” which is injecting the idea that America is an essentially unjust nation into the curricula of America’s K-12 schools. Please consider getting [**“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zl3bojjln84kcg6pnqd74seec60i9oa1j07aml7o_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdjm8or2chh2bs) as a DVD set for your home library or to give as a gift. **Good Morning**! On this date in 1944, Supreme Allied Commander General Dwight D. Ukraine has used U.S.-supplied long-range missiles to strike at [targets inside Russia ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0D1vgzAQxvFPA5sj4_MLDB66ZEvXjuiwz-EaB5BxiPrtKzp3fPQsP_2_buMNOfNy_8Qn-ZrWEUPlg0YrrFB61G30iUgRtOQ71znrXGe6dvYaJzNIE00kDMn0BhRoM9gpJmm6YWjZK6m0tNLK3tjOXUKCaJQGVBaU7F2jJUWua7l8r7zUmVL-WQ8ql7A-2-znWre9gY9GXRt1xW2h935e5yiVQ6ZGXV-PgryQKK99ZxRvwm1ddjFxpEU8ZiwPPkTQNkBAmWTS_QChDzBJSgZocFpD3xYftzfnzLs9Vfcncv5T1H-THF79BgAA___KGGIC)in recent days, U.S. officials said Wednesday.

Russian President Vladimir Putin reiterated his previous warning about using Western weapons against Russian targets. On Wednesday, he said [Russia could retaliate](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1u7CAQRp_GdF7BgAe7oLjNdnvblBaGYXcS_COMvcrbR06d8tNXnKPz8RgfnjMvz_9-JlfTOvpQ-aQRW2zBjEZEl4iAtCCnrLJoreqUeDmwyYRp0qrzgXQ0OKHvbRwkWiQ9WMEOJBiJEmXfobK3kHTswGgPqEH2tjGSIte13D5XXuqLUv5eTyq3sM4iu1et297ofw3cG7j7baH3fl3XKJVDpgbu5dh39u12VF7a46t4XqglNcAgDXYAoCYYKMXQ91H6BFopQ6K4uL05Z97xsnjOnvMvtf6Z4HTwEwAA__95HVur) by providing long-range weapons for use against Western nations. _"That would mark their direct involvement in the war against the Russian Federation, and we reserve the right to act the same way,"_ Putin said.

Current U.S. policy allows Ukraine to use U.S.-supplied weapons to defend the city of Kharkiv, which is located 12 miles from the Russian border.

Milwaukee County

The Republican Party of Milwaukee County held a Roundtable discussion with Eric Hovde and Latino Business owners on the Southside of Milwaukee at Botanas Restaurant. RPMC Chairman Hilario Deleon unveiled the County Party’s new Latino Coalition at the event.

Monroe County

Monroe County Republicans enthusiastically attended and held our normal Conservative Breakfast at the Monroe County Dairy Breakfast on SAT, JUN 1 near Kendall, WI. Those in attendance included State Senator Pat Testin, REP Nancy VanderMeer, Senate candidate Stacey Klein, Assembly candidate Cedric Schnitzler, and Monroe County Sheriff Wes Revels. Kendall Legion Commander Doug Rogalla led the Color Guard in posting the colors at the Opening Ceremony.

Kenosha County

The Republican Party of Kenosha County hosted a meet and greet with Congressman Bryan Steil followed by a town hall on border security. Leadership also attended RNC briefing in WI with Chairman Schimming and Reince Priebus.

Wood County

Wood County Republican Party hosted a drive through nomination papers signing. Wood County also opened up the RPW/RPWC office, signing up new members, handing out signs, and getting ready for the election season!

# NEWS
We are pleased to inform you of a significant update regarding our monthly meetings. Our new venue will be located in Redondo Beach. Additionally, we are shifting our meeting day to the second Monday of each month.
Mark your calendars for our upcoming "Meet the Candidates" event on Monday, June 10th. Doors will open promptly at 6:30 PM, providing an excellent opportunity for you to engage with the candidates.
Event Details:
Date: Monday, June 10th
Time: Doors open at 6:30 PM
Location: Immanuel Lutheran Church, 706 Knob Hill Ave, Redondo Beach
Please refer to the attached graphic for information on some of the candidates.
We look forward to your participation and are excited about the opportunities this new location and schedule will bring. Nena R. Gates

# Why I'm Voting for Mark Robertson
---
By Bruce Woodbury
I'm supporting Mark Robertson as my Representative (and your Representative) in Congress. Mark is a man of integrity and honor who will be loyal to the Constitution. I trust that he will do the right thing in Washington. Here are three specific reasons I support Mark:
Mark supports parents' right to choose the best education option for their children. Mark is the only candidate who has taught in our local elementary and high school schools and at UNLV. Mark and his wife Lesly have four children - two are teachers, and two are married to teachers. No one understands education challenges better than Mark Robertson. As our Representative, he will fight to support teachers and give parents the right to choose the best schools for their children.
Mark knows how to balance a budget and tame inflation. Mark is the only candidate with a degree in finance and an MBA. He taught finance at UNLV. He owned a financial planning business for 20years that helped families and small businesses balance their budgets and plan for their future. No one is better prepared to tackle our nation's financial problems than Mark Robertson. As our Representative, he will work hard to protect Social Security, reduce inflation, and shrink the size and burden of government.
Mark knows how to defend us. Mark is the only candidate running in CD-1 who is a Veteran. He spent 30 years in the Army, including multiple combat tours and assignments to the Pentagon and the National Defense University. He knows we must secure the border and support local law enforcement. This is why five former Police chiefs endorse him. As our Representative, Mark will work hard to stop the illegal flow of guns, gangs, and drugs into our county and community.
In summary, I support Mark Robertson because he has the knowledge and experience to solve our nation's biggest problems: Education, Inflation, and National Security. Mark is the only candidate who has taught in our schools, has an advanced degree in finance, and has served our Nation in the Armed Forces. He is the right person to be our Representative in Congress.
Editor's Note: Bruce Woodbury served on the Clark County Commission for 28 years (twice as Chairman). The I-215 beltway is named after him. He currently serves as Chairman of the Robertson for Congress Campaign.
---
******** Your Questions--Mark's Answers
Q. What do you think about Dina Titus refusing to vote in favor of censuring Rashida Tlaib? -J.S. A. I believe most people in Nevada's First Congressional District recognize that it is morally wrong for Tlaib to call for the annihilation of Jews and the destruction of the nation of Israel. Titus once again ignored the will of her constituents and stuck to her extreme ideology. We need a change in Washington. We need a congressman who truly represents the people. I will.
*******
Did you know you can actually call and talk with Mark? Yes, you can!
Use this link: [https://calendly.com/robertson-for-congress/phonecall-with-mark](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001xvRMeP4_AQ-7DQvlFRBq04QNJEjRKYGoV6gkv6SebDWn4vAEd87dvNxqtxmb5yIPNp1DselNQAhEvDRmwlCQrcMmxitQYyHIvawgzJFXhQYTJys4YEXqpI_I2oit5nP48hUZdCIfNE5pXVd6po3fUAmE8LX3C0h6oRE4IsjSNghG0fQeGWBfWoODMYVH57ELa1-1qAQs9pA=&c=_SHJIVrHdYf478rRRWKV0pAhRTC14qWla82tKkUhovzE9bSpnQUMjQ==&ch=DjYhFpqzhkqcxgiS_f3VhzIAaCdWrHI7MLCxVZXKS7YYJaWQupDslg==). You can easily schedule a call with Mark at a time that is convenient to you. It's your chance to ask him all the questions you have and find out more about Mark's platform.

Please share this message with friends and neighbors. Have questions for Mark? Simply reply to this email to ask him a question.

But we must not lose hope. Instead, we must fight back with the truth. Hillsdale College has been engaging the Left on the battlefield of education from the beginning. That's why we've turned our course, [**" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=bc67b0c14d534fee942c0cf15ceee599&_e=5RMj4jkdmdwDcQLwqW5kynnKS25gQD_pfUF2NwYUNnx0bOqqokOREVpV366lC3e_gM-3s5Tns7NPU-MJW1f5MQDPqPP5fvJGg6vT2-Js8ns7Uq82-kiz0wb0FXlLsDhMBD3Drl3DDUQOq3YwYQVgjMpCm2fAtNqs9mYJV1znZseu4e7t54h5b8Tpqk5qqvwm4Ychv7rl8c6v-z10xx9IXs6_CdyDPOHXxG_h4RWgjqDYM-feS7B-rmRzC_u-yQkMqiBnVyWzcxW6vYaMxRobjlprUaLOfVSVkyLA-vtWpKMt9tVSG9l9s_BfiVbBQ2iadlXgt1efT4PxvSYRNTIQciGEe49oZ02Vf8OTJSkHB_TqAShPCEi7Dw74yTL2NDs1HyWdDG7Zt5sGvnTO9nRfWpbh59auP8uleH8y_0Y-Qr0%3D) into a DVD set, and I'd like you to have a copy. # Become a Associate Member of the GOP
I am pleased to announce my recent victories and new roles within our political landscape, which mark significant milestones in our shared journey toward impactful governance. I was honored to secure a seat on the 66th Central Committee with the highest vote count in the entire Los Angeles County race. I have also been elected Vice President of the California Republican Assembly. These achievements reflect our collective dedication and the strength of our vision. Our mission is multifaceted, with a primary focus on invigorating conservative and Republican participation in the electoral process. Voter turnout has been on a decline for decades, particularly within faith communities, where less than 23% of Christians are participating in elections. Addressing this critical issue is imperative for our party and nation's future. To this end, I have been entrusted with revitalizing the Associate Member Program for the 66th Assembly. Your involvement is crucial as we strategize, receive training, and actively engage in initiatives designed to increase voter turnout and political participation. Together, we can create a legacy of civic responsibility and ensure a better future for our children and grandchildren. By joining us as an Associate Delegate, you will gain invaluable insights and hands-on experience. You will have the opportunity to contribute to essential discussions, participate in strategy sessions, and attend significant LAGOP and CRP functions. This role will also open doors for you to sit on various commissions and committees, expanding your influence and impact within our community. Please follow the link below to sign up and become an Associate Delegate for the 66th Assembly. Your participation will be instrumental in our efforts to restore robust voter engagement and uphold the values we cherish. [CLICK TO SIGN UP AS AN ASSOCIATE MEMBER](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5257?id=262781.352.1.ff030cd239cf67ff19c981a5085094ec) Thank you for your commitment to our cause. Together, we can make a difference. Fighting For You All,
Derrick Gates
Vice President, California Republican Assembly

clean_body: We are happy to let you know about a significant update regarding our monthly meetings for the South Bay CRA. Our new venue will be located in Redondo | | | We are happy to let you know about a significant update regarding our monthly meetings for the South Bay CRA. Our new venue will be located in Redondo Beach. Additionally, we are shifting our meeting day to the second Monday of each month. Mark your calendars for our upcoming "Meet the Candidates" event on Monday, June 10th. Doors will open right away at 6:30 PM, giving you an excellent opportunity for you to talk with the candidates. Event Details: Date: Monday, June 10th Time: Doors open at 6:30 PM Location: Immanuel Lutheran Church, 706 Knob Hill Ave, Redondo Beach Please take a look at the attached graphic for information on some of the candidates. Time: Doors open at 6:30 PM Location: Immanuel Lutheran Church, 706 Knob Hill Ave, Redondo Beach Become a Associate Member of the GOP I am pleased to announce my recent victories and new roles within our political landscape, which mark significant milestones in our shared journey toward impactful governance. I was honored to secure a seat on the 66th Central Committee with the highest vote count in the entire Los Angeles County race. I have also been elected Vice President of the California Republican Assembly. These achievements reflect our collective dedication and the strength of our vision. Our mission is multifaceted, with a primary focus on invigorating conservative and Republican participation in the electoral process. Voter turnout has been on a decline for decades, particularly within faith communities, where less than 23% of Christians are participating in elections. Addressing this critical issue is imperative for our party and nation's future. To this end, I have been entrusted with revitalizing the Associate Member Program for the 66th Assembly. Your involvement is crucial as we strategize, receive training, and actively engage in initiatives designed to increase voter turnout and political participation. Together, we can create a legacy of civic responsibility and ensure a better future for our children and grandchildren. By joining us as an Associate Delegate, you will gain invaluable insights and hands-on experience. You will have the opportunity to contribute to essential discussions, participate in strategy sessions, and attend significant LAGOP and CRP functions. This role will also open doors for you to sit on various commissions and committees, expanding your influence and impact within our community. Please follow the link below to sign up and become an Associate Delegate for the 66th Assembly. Your participation will be instrumental in our efforts to restore robust voter engagement and uphold the values we cherish. Thank you for your commitment to our cause. Together, we can make a difference. Fighting For You All, Derrick Gates Vice President, California Republican Assembly 66th Assembly District Central Committee LAGOP | Border Video | Click to Watch Add my Social Media | After my Social Media pages all got nuked during the last few years I'm trying to build my pages back up. A Message from Rudy: [My Journey with Coffee](https://o6acimgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001H9rWW5gOtWBZ9Csw5RXfYCRICvlif3DV43GT6Iwx1aZ887WK4J8ZjmXNlMFxPYxF4z4qUNZ7jJMWBpiYOj16iGC2zWQ57tx-BUHgG9sZJbN2HJGUvVVd_ll8YtmrP1NNE7nQauh5eRgtrulFDI1qUw==&c=6CyZ-WplF61ENhvlpnb_7Ejmn8r5QI4ABX2y0jt79kT-UmGAnZEr4Q==&ch=rPUJROZQn5uZLztoTtxQRlQXSDHZ9UNRXXQfCaeXfLeM5gofAjOePg==)
---
| Dear friends,
I am really excited to tell you about my journey with coffee. Approximately four years ago I started mixing different coffee beans for different flavors. Friends and family started to call me "Rudy the Barista." I research everything. I actually went to a class about the different coffee machines! I found top notch coffee bean grinders as well.
Approximately six months ago, during a business strategy meeting, I brewed some coffee. Dr. Maria, my co-host and president of Giuliani Communications, said it was the best coffee she ever had and suggested, on the spot, that we start our own brand.
So, we got right down to business. Dr. Maria is incredibly fastidious, and turns down business opportunities that do not meet her quality standards or the price point is too much for hardworking patriots and their families, especially with such high inflation. We didn't want to sacrifice quality, which led us to Arabica beans.
Many coffees on the market have Robusta beans, which is an inferior quality. Robusta beans grow at a low altitude where there's lots of bugs so insecticides are used frequently. Arabica beans grow at high altitudes and do not experience massive bug infestations.
We use a Swiss water process to remove the caffeine for the decaf coffee. Other company's use chemicals to remove the caffeine. Our journey led us to Burke Brand Coffee and overnight, [Rudy.Coffee](https://o6acimgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001H9rWW5gOtWBZ9Csw5RXfYCRICvlif3DV43GT6Iwx1aZ887WK4J8ZjmXNlMFxPYxF4z4qUNZ7jJMWBpiYOj16iGC2zWQ57tx-BUHgG9sZJbN2HJGUvVVd_ll8YtmrP1NNE7nQauh5eRgtrulFDI1qUw==&c=6CyZ-WplF61ENhvlpnb_7Ejmn8r5QI4ABX2y0jt79kT-UmGAnZEr4Q==&ch=rPUJROZQn5uZLztoTtxQRlQXSDHZ9UNRXXQfCaeXfLeM5gofAjOePg==) was born!
We are so elated to offer bold, regular, and decaf coffee. Please go to [Rudy.Coffee](https://o6acimgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001H9rWW5gOtWBZ9Csw5RXfYCRICvlif3DV43GT6Iwx1aZ887WK4J8ZjmXNlMFxPYxF4z4qUNZ7jJMWBpiYOj16iGC2zWQ57tx-BUHgG9sZJbN2HJGUvVVd_ll8YtmrP1NNE7nQauh5eRgtrulFDI1qUw==&c=6CyZ-WplF61ENhvlpnb_7Ejmn8r5QI4ABX2y0jt79kT-UmGAnZEr4Q==&ch=rPUJROZQn5uZLztoTtxQRlQXSDHZ9UNRXXQfCaeXfLeM5gofAjOePg==) and order your coffee today.
Best,
Mayor Rudy Giuliani

Dear Peter,
If we don’t change the path we're on, the American people will go from citizen to subject – _subject to our government and their complicit corporate accomplices_.
I am the only candidate for President who will make sure that doesn’t happen. When I am President, you, the people, will be in charge.
I may be independent but I am not independent of you. Join our team and let’s get our country back on track!
---

---
As President, Here are five things I will do to get the country back on the right track:
1. Dismantle the broken two-party system: Put you, the people, back in charge.
2. Secure the border and save American jobs: Fill the gaps in the wall and reinstate the migrant protection act requiring those with asylum claims to remain in Mexico.
3. Significantly drop the level of chronic disease in our children: I have been committed to this my entire career and if I can’t accomplish this in my first term, do not re-elect me.
4. Stop the Federal Government from lying to you: Any federal employee caught lying will be dismissed.
5. Revive the American Dream: It used to be if you worked hard and played by the rules, you could buy a home and raise a family ... and all on one job. I will take on the corporations stifling the American Dream and return it to you.

I am not afraid to meet this challenge. I will change the path we’re and put you back in charge! But I can’t do it without you on the team.
Let’s change the path together! name: Ronny Jackson and Derrick Van Orden, US Navy Veterans
subject: Geronimo!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Van Orden for Congress
body:
We just made a big jump into Normandy on D-Day. Let us explain why:

| |
---
| | | | | | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zcfd712gvng34ubaiccca3asea1v6jqvvl0pgg6o_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdie8ob4cph2bs "Ronny Jackson, US Navy Veteran")
---
| | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z70jj1d2pcbgbg4hejhgov4umkqf7lo970u3sq18_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdie8ob4cph2bs "Ret. US Navy SEAL Derrick Van Orden")
---
Geronimo!

It's US Navy Veterans Ronny Jackson and Derrick Van Orden. We just made a big jump into Normandy on D-Day. **Let us explain why:**

_We did this to honor the Greatest Generation, Friend._ More than 130,000 American troops invaded Normandy beginning on June 6, 1944. And a lot of those soldiers made the ultimate sacrifice in service of this country.

This year marks the 80th anniversary of D-Day. We may be eight decades removed from the invasion, but we will _**NEVER**_ forget the sacrifices so many Americans made.

That's why we made this jump, Friend. Now more than ever, it is _crucial_ that we honor and preserve the legacy of the Greatest Generation. **Patriotism isn 't just in decline in America today; _it 's even _CONDEMNED_ by radical Leftists!_**

It's sad to see, but just complaining about the state of our country won't fix anything. It's up to good, patriotic Americans like us to carry the torch. We love our country, Friend. Ronny served our nation for 25 years and Derrick gave 26 years of service. If you served then you know how important it is that we preserve patriotism in this country. If you didn't, _then please trust these two Navy veterans!_

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to receive this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT from Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=627da89bc9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

Don Tracy Ally Jeanne Ives Attacks Grassroots on Facebook as Powerful Voter Base Abandons Angry Radio Host (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/don-tracy-ally-jeanne-ives-attacks-grassroots-on-facebook-as-powerful-voter-base-abandons-angry-radio-host.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=627da89bc9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Jeanne Ives on March 2, 2018. (Andy Abeyta/Quad-City Times)

By Illinois Review
On Monday, Illinois Republican State Central Committee member Jeanne Ives – a close ally to embattled IL GOP chairman Don Tracy – went on Facebook to publicly slam her own constituents – the conservative grassroots base of the party – for emailing and asking about an incident that took place during the state convention – angrily posting, “canned emails get a canned response.”
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/don-tracy-ally-jeanne-ives-attacks-grassroots-on-facebook-as-powerful-voter-base-abandons-angry-radio-host.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=627da89bc9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Earlier on Monday, the powerful and influential base of the Republican Party – the grassroots – sent emails to IL GOP leaders including Ives, asking why SSC member Mark Shaw – who was running for national committeeman – was spotted wearing a “delegate” badge during the state convention when he was not an actual delegate. As a delegate, Shaw could vote for himself for national committeeman – a vote that wouldn’t help, as he would lose the election in a landslide (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/grassroots-dominate-il-gop-state-convention-and-expand-influence-as-state-party-leaders-lose-their-cool.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=627da89bc9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) to the grassroots-backed candidate Dean White. But growing agitated by the influx of emails concerning Shaw, Ives decided to go on her Facebook page and post a comment that read, “You send a canned email, you get a canned response...at least I replied to your canned email.”
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/don-tracy-ally-jeanne-ives-attacks-grassroots-on-facebook-as-powerful-voter-base-abandons-angry-radio-host.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=627da89bc9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/don-tracy-ally-jeanne-ives-attacks-grassroots-on-facebook-as-powerful-voter-base-abandons-angry-radio-host.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=627da89bc9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
The comment drew an immediate backlash as Republicans fired back calling Ives’ comment “ignorant” and “belittling” to the constituents she’s supposed to represent. In her “canned” reply, Ives stated “Thank you for contacting me. This email is to confirm that I received your input and to let you know that I will look into the matter. Jeanne Ives, IL 3rd SCC.”

body:

| | | | | Peter, In just a moment [**I am going to ask you to split a $10 contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Arizona with Blue Amp Action.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T42b4b649-c58a-40a3-bf7b-0bccbdce756b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Please, give me a chance to explain why this request is so important. Here goes: Trump is going to have a town hall in North Phoenix today, later this afternoon. It’s his first visit to Arizona since 2022. It’s his first major public appearance since he was charged with 34 felonies last week. And it’s a huge sign of how important Arizona is to his re-election. The GOP has seen a massive increase in their fundraising since Trump’s verdict last week. The Trump campaign took in more than $140 million in May, with $70 million coming in the 48 hours after that verdict. Kari Lake is sure to be raking in the cash right now, too. That couldn’t possibly happen at a worse time for us. June is an official FEC deadline month, and once we hit that deadline we’re legally required to report our numbers. It is critical that we show strength. But while Trump and Kari Lake are filling their coffers, we’re emptying ours. We’re spending millions right now, but our fundraising continues to slow down. If we don’t pick up the pace we are in serious trouble. Trump and Lake will do whatever they can to win Arizona. That’s why he’s coming to Phoenix, and it’s why he’ll probably attack me directly this afternoon. He’s got to tear down my campaign to win this state. So, I need your help. I need a huge fundraising day today, and I need you to chip in before he takes the stage. This could not be more important — really. [Can you make today the day you make a split $10 contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate? The amount we raise is important here, but not nearly as important as the amount of donations we receive. I need all of my top supporters today. I need you, Peter. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tce660472-a66b-4b9f-8766-ab79e0370774/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Friend,

I wanted to take a few minutes today to tell you a little bit about myself, my life story, and what's never going to change.

**__My Upbringing__**
I was raised in Zachary, Louisiana where I was taught the values I live by today by my mother and father. Those same values that I fight for each and every single day to protect. Values like hard work, dedication, and putting God and family first in everything.

[](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=4389f6d27fd64bd18833e1550b122f38&_e=zuLQMrkjY3RnBh7uuUeBs6L7TtnonVvSrNwKOuuH2E39hEzKTZfRI-MQLZln_woj50dovpK-fUg-mguXORnSH5Bc8cTTwojjhc15_-fUpAQcPVu2-URf7kASCD7CNgiFEKvG05kj_14wcrUl8xkcnj_pXYV_lB3Fbj-pWAhPuCi5y68YdhAgfYtqarVYicA1UvecqEkUxuWqFDvJgXZy46O8_U1ngXd9mcz626jbflP0WmhM11nmnFRpx5RtmpJzSWC6Wt3GE8qcFzNZhZAzRLeMabSOtMoDmvyBElUKSPvsKaE37a91uI4_-09JYsEOUZzlrMm7qYJh_41Wa1bj8zshSmsiFIW8sEbRav3p_kqJ_2R3cP3xUUBFZDwzfEIK)
After high school, I attended Vanderbilt University, graduated, and then went on to receive my law degree at the University of Virginia. I tell you that so you know that I know a little more about law than the average pink-haired woker would like you to believe.

**__So, what 'd I do after college?__**
I was elected to five terms as State Treasurer where I managed the state's $10.6 billion investment portfolios. I also oversaw local and state bond issues and returned millions of dollars in unclaimed property each year. Before I was Treasurer, I served as Secretary of the Department of Revenue, Special Counsel to Governor Roemer, and Secretary of Governor Roemer's Cabinet.

[](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=4389f6d27fd64bd18833e1550b122f38&_e=zuLQMrkjY3RnBh7uuUeBs6L7TtnonVvSrNwKOuuH2E39hEzKTZfRI-MQLZln_woj50dovpK-fUg-mguXORnSH5Bc8cTTwojjhc15_-fUpAQcPVu2-URf7kASCD7CNgiFEKvG05kj_14wcrUl8xkcnj_pXYV_lB3Fbj-pWAhPuCi5y68YdhAgfYtqarVYicA1UvecqEkUxuWqFDvJgXZy46O8_U1ngXd9mcz626jbflNApmsvzF5ziVG5jY6yOy7doAaefe3UbvATlS1llmqP-mzvZ81Ra8eynv_mhMw51PtK0M21uOqOgLNPezEKXZ1v_bbaFl3WKv_lqbZKWGMDZiHZbu4PFnQfdD8Xlgg-OMijHrPBErD7pIbp4g_FaGwB)
Then, I got my biggest call. **The call to help the people of Louisiana and America.**

**_Time as U.S. Senator of Louisiana_**
I was elected to the U.S. Senate in 2016 after being endorsed by none other than President Donald J. Trump. I serve on the Appropriations, Banking, Housing and Urban Affairs, Budget, Judiciary, and Small Business and Entrepreneurship committees in the U.S. Senate. I serve as the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Energy and Water Development for the Appropriations Committee, the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Federal Courts for the Judiciary Committee, and the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Economic Policy for the Banking Committee.

[](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=4389f6d27fd64bd18833e1550b122f38&_e=zuLQMrkjY3RnBh7uuUeBs6L7TtnonVvSrNwKOuuH2E39hEzKTZfRI-MQLZln_woj50dovpK-fUg-mguXORnSH5Bc8cTTwojjhc15_-fUpAQcPVu2-URf7kASCD7CNgiFEKvG05kj_14wcrUl8xkcnj_pXYV_lB3Fbj-pWAhPuCi5y68YdhAgfYtqarVYicA1UvecqEkUxuWqFDvJgXZy46O8_U1ngXd9mcz626jbflPCfcFAOC6vNWCWo8YmxHhDmwRRY-HBrKV3jGSJm5kF3DzBS58LbQeVNcbuD8_BF-JvlK14e_R2RUHNH41eObADaVUaXSPwSUqkZ-CwSmSrQMZCZmmgEagGtt1mVpl5O0hqZhD1MXxVpmJ4m4fpR7xh)
Every day for me is a new challenge, another day to serve the people of Louisiana, and another day to fight for our conservative values. You see, I'm always going to be **100% PRO-LIFE, PRO-GUN****,** and **PRO-FREEDOM**. That's not going to change regardless of what the Neo-Socialist Left throws at me and you can write that down and take it home to mama.

**I 'm going to fight for your rights, your freedoms, and for a better future for our children. **

body:

Friends,
I am reaching out to you today with an urgent call for your support as we embark on this journey to transform our rural Michigan.
We have just over 60 days until the primary election. Some voters begin voting later this month! The time to defeat Rep. Bergman starts now, first, with a decisive win in our Democratic primary. I need your continued support, loyalty, and generosity to do it.
drbob.me/aboutbob [drbob.me/aboutbob]
CONTRIBUTE [drbob.me/aboutbob]
Friends,
As awful as Bergman's record is, defeating a four-time Republican incumbent is no small feat. But we will overcome the hurdles ahead. By persisting as a second-time challenger, we've got the best shot - and we're in this to win it.
Your contribution will help us counter the influence of MAGA extremist Rep. Bergman and ensure that our relentless grassroots efforts and positive campaign continue to be the driving force of this rural movement.
I'm running for Congress to fight for our families, our freedoms, and our future.
As we aim to build a better future for Michigan's 1st District, we're focusing on issues such as robust infrastructure, reliable connectivity, affordable childcare, high-quality local education, jobs with livable wages, and support for existing and new businesses.
By supporting our campaign, you are helping us demonstrate what is possible when we have affordable and available housing, access to quality healthcare, workers' rights, and energy independence while protecting the environment and addressing climate change.
With your backing, we can also defend the rights of our LGBTQ community and uphold the hard-won rights of our grandmothers, ensuring that our granddaughters don't have to refight these battles.
Join our fight.
-Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser

Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

If you’re in a rush, here’s the short version: Right-wing extremists have a **900+ page plan** to completely dismantle our democracy in the first 180 days of a Trump presidency. They want to ban abortion nationwide, overhaul the entire federal bureaucracy, roll back any progress we’ve made for LGBTQ+ rights, and commit all kinds of human rights violations for their own political agendas.
The bottom line is that we cannot let them get away with this. We’re mobilizing young voters to fight back, but we need your support. [Can we count on you to chip in and support the fight for our democracy?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86368851/477684609/742098171?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS85OTMyMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OGEyYzAzOC0wYzI0LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=g8WCKl3HFy31lUNWnvfc1Zz9TT9o9Vqvue4e2HNOLQw=&emci=226ce09b-9e23-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=88a2c038-0c24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=6787172)

There’s no easy way to say this, so we’ll just come right out with it: Letting young voters sit home and do nothing on Election Day 2024 will have disastrous results.
We don’t say that to be dramatic; we say it because we read the GOP’s 920-page plan and they make it very clear that they’re out for blood.
**If young voters don’t show up and make their voices heard in November, we can say goodbye to democracy as we know it in the U.S.**
Here’s what’s going on — the MAGA zealots are on a mission to get Trump a second term. And to make his transition to power easier for him, right-wing groups have raised $20 million toward what they’re calling **Project 2025.**
If MAGA extremists get their way, Project 2025 will be the blueprint for a Trump dictatorship on his first day in office.
Here’s what they have planned:
* Instituting a nationwide abortion ban
* Blocking federal financial aid for millions of college students if their state allows certain immigrant groups, including Dreamers with legal status, to access in-state tuition
* Terminating the legal status of 500,000 DACA recipients by eliminating staff time for reviewing and processing renewal applications

That isn’t even half of what they have planned. And if we don’t take a stand in November, these far-right nutjobs will get their way.

## Remembering D-Day
---
|
---
On June 6th, 1944, the Allies began an invasion to liberate France and the rest of Western Europe from Nazi control. Over the course of this invasion, many Americans were willing to sacrifice their lives to fight fascism and restore freedom throughout the entirety of the Western World. Their heroism during one of the darkest chapters in history is a great example of the courage and resilience of our American servicemembers. The Normandy landings became the largest seaborne invasion in history, involving nearly 5,000 landing and assault craft, 289 escort vessels, and 277 minesweepers. The success of D-Day was not without its challenges and massive losses. Around 160,000 troops crossed the English Channel on D-Day, with 875,000 disembarking by the end of June. Despite Allied casualties of at least 10,000 on the first day, including 4,414 confirmed dead, the Germans failed to repel the invasion. The Normandy campaign evolved into a grueling battle of attrition, underscoring the resilience of both Allied forces and the tenacity of the enemy. Despite setbacks, the Allied advance prevailed, leading to the liberation of France and the eventual defeat of Nazi Germany. As we honor the sacrifices of our veterans, we must also recognize the ongoing struggle against fascism and oppression we see today. Their legacy serves as a reminder of the importance of remaining vigilant in defense of democracy, liberty, and equality. The fight against fascism is not confined to the annals of history but remains a pertinent endeavor in our contemporary world. In commemorating our veterans, let us reaffirm our commitment to upholding the values for which they bravely fought. Their sacrifices will forever be etched in the annals of history, inspiring future generations to stand against tyranny and injustice. With deepest gratitude,The Team at No Dem Left Behind

| | Pride Month is about honoring the LGBTQ+ trailblazers who have bravely fought for our rights throughout history. It’s about celebrating the joy, authenticity, and freedom that every LGBTQ+ person deserves. It’s about recognizing how far we’ve come, and how far we have left to go. Don’t forget, Pride began as a protest. Fair Fight Action’s vision for Georgia — and our democracy — includes everyone. That means making sure our laws protect our queer, trans, and nonbinary neighbors, not target them. But once again, right wing extremists have waged relentless attacks on LGBTQ+ folks across the country this year — including right here in Georgia. Nearly 20 anti-LGBTQ+ bills were introduced during this past legislative session, including hateful and discriminatory bills like Senate Bill 88 and House Bill 1128 that could have furthered anti-LGBTQ+ sentiment in our state:
* Senate Bill 88, a “Don’t Say Gay'' bill, singled out the topic of gender identity in schools for specific regulation — a practice that could stigmatize LGBTQ+ youth and would have set the stage for public school districts to force teachers to out transgender students to their parents.
* House Bill 1128 opened the door for discrimination against people whose gender does not match their sex assigned at birth; and sought to remove sexual orientation and gender from Georgia’s hate crimes criteria and investigative procedures. It would have effectively removed equitable protections for LGBTQ+ people who are victims of crimes.

**[Thankfully, these bills did not pass — but that doesn’t mean they won’t keep trying. A gift from you today can help mobilize against harmful legislation and respond to future threats to our fundamental rights and more.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86375314/477705268/-395405885?refcode=bsc_emm_ffa_20240605_f_pride2024_v1s3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhN2ViZTdiMS0xNDI0LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zTOYusTRKBSFpzdIqIzOYVf0AjntokoWIoph3GYSexo=)** It’s no surprise that the same lawmakers working to restrict the right to vote are also attacking the LGBTQ+ community. When we have the freedom to make our voices heard at the ballot box, we have more power to protect LGBTQ+ rights and stop anti-LGBTQ+ extremism. We won’t let these attacks rain on our Pride parade — here’s to showing up fully and authentically this month! subject: Join Bill LIVE This Sunday
body:
Peter, We’re excited to invite you to join an exclusive live broadcast of the Common Ground Podcast this Sunday at 11:00AM ET
|
---
| Peter, We’re excited to invite you to join an exclusive live broadcast of the Common Ground Podcast this Sunday (June 9th) at 11:00AM ET, directly from the vibrant Ria Mar Restaurant and Bar in South River, New Jersey.
---
|
---
This will be an engaging episode filled with local charm and special guests from the community. [**Click here to tune in when Bill goes live this Sunday morning at 11:00AM ET.**](https://xtz223.keap-link019.com/v2/click/ff4fd2df09d3a43af7b9c56a478709a0/eJyNkMFqwkAQht9lzqlpEgUbKMVa0ZAoRarSU1mTKV1MNsNm1nSVvHtXK_bSQi9zme__fmaOwKiE4qSAGD75EIYReKAxlyRR8bhWLPLzNhz0gyjwoJRqN9W1IYiPv4avwDkVDW49YEvokJflaJwmi-lblixSR5LQruOfnuGPZzIfJRl03Z9irCRP9s7dQMza4OmiQrqreKVLx38wUxP7ftu2PVsbNlvs5XXlUylsKRt-OI375-xxdsD9q9qaitMbRXq2e7p7Xw7tJlhv8mAlXJUgQlVc_pSi_S7svgCTRnHQ) Bill will explore the rich history of South River, particularly its surprising connection to NFL greatness, and discuss key issues facing our community today with the very people who know it best.

---
| **Featuring Special Guests:**
* **Mayor Peter Guindi:** Hear from South River’s mayor about the latest community developments.
* **Rui Baptista:** Join the conversation with the owner of Ria Mar, discussing the history of this beloved local establishment.
* **Chief of Police Mark Tinitigan:** Get insights on public safety and community engagement from our chief of police.
* **Joe Theismann:** Former Washington Redskins quarterback and proud South River graduate.
* **Drew Pearson:** Hall of Famer and former Dallas Cowboys quarterback, also a graduate of South River.

Don’t miss this unique opportunity to connect with your community through lively discussions and stories that celebrate our local heroes and history. See you for an afternoon of insightful conversation and community spirit! Until Next Time, Common Sense Action Team

name: Joe Pereles
subject: Proud of what we’re doing
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pereles for Missouri, Rhonda West, Treasurer
body:
https://www.perelesformissouri.com/ [https://www.perelesformissouri.com/]
Peter,
This is my first run for political office. But it’s far from my first experience bringing people together and finding common ground to get things done.
When I was General Counsel & Senior VP for Development at Drury Hotels, I spent decades building relationships and crafting deals that enriched communities, generated hundreds of good-paying jobs, and invested in people and neighborhoods for the long term.
During that time, I remained active as a volunteer member of the Red Cross and have always looked for ways to get involved and help people in need. (In fact, I am writing this email to you from Washington, D.C., where I am attending a meeting of the National Philanthropic Board of the American Red Cross!)
Now, I am applying the knowledge I’ve gained across a lifetime of public service and building consensus in the business world to this campaign to put an end to the chaos and division in Jefferson City.
And here’s what I know we must do if we are going to win (which I know we will!): we must build and run the biggest, best door to door voter outreach program Senate District 15 has ever seen.
When I talk to folks at the doors, the reception I get blows me away. The thing I hear the most from people is that they are both surprised and relieved to have a candidate for office come to them and ask for their thoughts and then listen to their concerns. But having these conversations isn’t just a tactic to win an election—I see it as an essential duty for anyone seeking to represent people in government.
I have told my team that this approach is what I expect from them, and from myself. We will settle for nothing less. We won’t just say that “We Can Do Better”: we will show that we can!
If you can help us build our door to door team effort so that we can show the people of Senate District 15 what real leadership looks like, I would be so grateful. Thank you in advance for your support: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=bump-field]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=bump-field_donate]
I am so proud of what we’re doing in this campaign together. I hope that you are, too.
Sincerely,
Joe
P.S. If you can volunteer and join our team to knock doors and talk to voters, we would love to have you with us! We’re in the planning stages of a big volunteer field kickoff event. If you would like to join or want to start canvassing as soon as possible, please let us know by signing up here : [https://www.perelesformissouri.com/volunteer]
