| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Friend, this is sad but unfortunately not surprising.

First, photos showed Justice Samuel Alito and his family flew two politically charged flags outside their homes: an upside-down American flag, a symbol adopted by Trump supporters who claim the 2020 election was “stolen,” and an “Appeal to Heaven” flag recently associated with a theocratic ideology and carried by those who attacked the Capitol on January 6th, 2021.
With public trust in the Supreme Court at an all-time low, I and other of my Senate colleagues have called for Justice Alito to honor the judiciary’s mandate to remain impartial.

Now, Justice Alito has refused requests to recuse himself, maintaining that he has not acted in a manner in which his “impartiality might reasonably be questioned.” **Given the facts, it defies logic that Justice Alito could arrive at such a conclusion.**

I don’t blame you if you’re experiencing déjà vu right now, friend. We were here just over a month ago when Justice Clarence Thomas blatantly ignored calls to recuse himself from cases regarding January 6th because his wife, Ginni, was reportedly plotting to keep Trump in office.

**With their ties to the election denier movement and refusal to recuse themselves, Justices Alito and Thomas are doing grave damage to the Supreme Court’s reputation and credibility. They demean and undermine the discipline and dedication the other seven sitting Justices demonstrate daily. They sully our history.**
**Immediate action is necessary to rein in corruption and reestablish trust in our nation’s highest court:[That’s why I’ve just opened an urgent petition and am counting on 10,000 supporters to sign on now and demand a stronger code of ethics be established and enforced for Supreme Court justices. – Dick

clean_body: When I developed uterine fibroids it was like having an uninvited guest take over my body. = Peter, When I developed uterine fibroids, it was like having an uninvited guest take over my body for years. Eventually, the painful and unpredictable menstrual cycles left me with no choice but to resort to getting a hysterectomy. For too long, women have suffered in silence due to fibroids. Yet, despite being extremely common, the cause is unknown. That’s why I am proud to announce that I have introduced The Uterine Fibroid Intervention and Gynecological Health and Treatment Act (U-FIGHT Act). = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = | | = | = | | = | = | | = This legislation would award grants to increase early detection of and intervention for uterine fibroids, education and awareness programs, and research. The U-FIGHT Act also addresses Asherman’s syndrome, uterine scar tissue build-up following surgery, as well as disparities in pain control and management as it relates to uterine fibroids. Uterine fibroids are extremely common, frequently painful, and disproportionally impact Black women – yet there is no comprehensive federal program to address fibroids. I am proud to be leading the charge to change that. = Thank you, Shontel Brown As a Cuyahoga County Council member and Chairwoman of the Cuyahoga County Democratic Party, Shontel Brown has spent the last decade serving the people of Ohio and building coalitions. Now, as the Congresswoman for Ohio’s 11th District, she will fight for affordable quality health care, jobs that pay fair wages, a strong public education system, and equity and justice for all. | | | Trump's trial in Georgia (regarding his interference in the 2020 election along with co-conspirators like Rudy Giuliani) has been indefinitely halted by a Georgia appeals court until a panel of judges decides whether DA Fani Willis, the prosecutor, should be disqualified from the case. **Let's be clear what is happening – Republicans and Republican appointees are trying to delay justice because they know Trump is guilty as hell.** Fani Willis has been the target of attacks from Trump's team who have been searching for a reason to disqualify her, and now Trump has been handed a massive victory with this latest delay. This is exactly what Trump wants – to delay and delay his trials until after the 2024 election, until he can win the presidency and pardon himself, or even just ignore the courts altogether. We can't let it happen. Trump needs to be punished for his crimes, and the trial needs to happen as soon as possible. | | Peter, I wanted to share the new digital ad that Our Great Task launched today.

The ad, entitled "Noble Purpose," features previous Presidents of the United States speaking about the courage and sacrifice made by those who landed on the beaches of Normandy 80 years ago today to defend freedom and defeat tyranny. To conclude the video, former Congresswoman Liz Cheney states that "America deserves a president as good and steadfast as our nation, a president of character, driven by a noble purpose, one who honors the sacrifices of our troops. Not a man consumed by spite, revenge, and self-pity."

[Click here to watch the video](https://link.quorum.us/f/a/9ehpNc6HTMY1ndzP0snVOw~~/AACYXwA~/RgRoRF-KP0QcaHR0cHM6Ly9mYi53YXRjaC9zeHd0cTlYZTBFL1cDc3BjQgpmVavaYWYfQ3dWUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) and see below for a full transcript:

**"Noble Purpose" - (1:56)**[](https://link.quorum.us/f/a/0y6393f_UIp60QRzOPgYkQ~~/AACYXwA~/RgRoRF-KP0RoaHR0cHM6Ly9ncmVhdHRhc2sudXM2Lmxpc3QtbWFuYWdlLmNvbS90cmFjay9jbGljaz91PTE4ZWMzZjkwODQ1Y2VkYWNmODk3ZThjMGEmaWQ9YjI2MmUxNmYwNSZlPTZkZTkyNGJiZjBXA3NwY0IKZlWr2mFmH0N3VlIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**FORMER CONGRESSWOMAN LIZ CHENEY** : _On_ _June_ _6, 1944, President Roosevelt addressed the nation with a prayer for the troops landing on the beaches at Normandy._

**PRESIDENT FRANKLIN D. ROOSEVELT** : _Almighty God, our sons, pride of our nation, this day have set upon a might endeavor...They fight to end conquest. They fight to liberate. They fight to let justice arise, and tolerance and good will among all Thy people._

**FORMER PRESIDENT DWIGHT EISENHOWER** : _These men came here, British, and our other allies, and Americans, to storm these beaches for one purpose only. Not to gain anything for ourselves. Not to fulfill any ambitions that America had for conquest, but just to preserve freedom, systems of self-government in the world. Many thousands of men have died for ideals such as these._

**PRESIDENT RONALD REAGAN** : _One’s country is worth dying for, and democracy is worth dying for, because it’s the most deeply honorable form of government ever devised by man. All of you loved liberty. All of you were willing to fight tyranny, and you knew the people of your countries were behind you._

**PRESIDENT GEORGE W. BUSH** : _Today we give thanks for all that was gained on the beaches of Normandy. We remember what was lost, with respect, admiration and love...This freedom and these hopes are what the heroes of D-day fought and died for._

**CHENEY** : _America deserves a president as good and steadfast as our nation, a president of character, driven by a noble purpose, one who honors the sacrifices of our troops.

Not a man consumed by spite, revenge, and self-pity.

https://karenforvirginia.com/ [https://karenforvirginia.com/] Karen Jenkins for HB-89

We need to have a strong Republican in Congress to represent the state
of Alaska, and I believe I'm that person."

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Why are grocery prices so high?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
And my plan to fix this.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2197%2E4032634%2EdxaLCJ)
---
Let me state the obvious here for a second: Grocery store prices are too damn high. Giant corporations want you to think that it’s just because of inflation. But that’s ignoring two other big factors at play here: consolidation and greed. You see, when grocery stores have less competition, they have less incentive to attract consumers with lower prices or higher quality. And right now, just four big companies — Walmart, Costco, Kroger, and Ahold — control over 70% of the grocery market in most major cities. And this isn’t just about companies that own the grocery stores. It’s about the companies that fill the shelves. A couple of big cereal manufacturers control nearly 60% of the market. A single company controls about 20% of the egg market. Four corporations control 85% of the beef industry and 75% of the pork industry. How did we get here? Literally hundreds of mergers over the last 50 years. So with limited competition, grocery store and food giants are enabled to price gouge consumers and blame inflation. Families are now paying 25% more for groceries as compared to before the pandemic. Big food companies want to keep these huge profits and they're hiring plenty of lobbyists to keep Congress from acting. So I’m encouraging President Biden to exercise his executive authority to take additional action to address rising food prices without Congress. **[More on my plan below, but we need to show that Americans are paying attention to this issue and are calling for action. Please add your name if high grocery store prices are affecting you, and you agree that the greedy food and grocery store corporations need regulatory intervention.](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/EMZ20P_FIN_E_20240601_V1S1?refcode=EMZ20P_FIN_E_20240606_V1S1_i1&t=8&akid=2197%2E4032634%2EdxaLCJ)** | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2223?t=9&akid=2197%2E4032634%2EdxaLCJ)
---
President Biden has been bringing his administration to bear on this issue — taking robust action to push down costs for families.
Massachusetts Congressman Jim McGovern and I have written a letter to President Biden urging his administration to continue using all the tools on his desk like to address rising food prices and lower food prices for families. This includes:
* Encouraging the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) to work with the U.S. Department of Agriculture to prohibit exclusionary contracting by dominant firms in the food industry.
* Urging the Department of Justice (DOJ) and the FTC to scrutinize, and where appropriate, block mergers and acquisitions in the food and agricultural sectors.
* Tapping in the DOJ to prosecute actors in the agricultural and food sectors for price fixing and other anticompetitive behavior.
* Directing the CFTC and FTC to form a joint task force to investigate food price manipulation throughout the supply chain.

And that’s just to name a few of the tools we have to tackle this. These actions from the administration would complement my Price Gouging Prevention Act and Shrinkflation Prevention Act with Senator Bob Casey, which would crack down on corporate price gouging across the board.
Look, families are identifying the cost of food and groceries as the top issue they've been facing. The federal government should use every possible tool to lower food prices — whether that’s by passing legislation or using the authority of federal departments.
**[I’m pulling on every lever possible to get relief to working families. Please add your name to say you support this work and you agree that the government should step in and hold giant food and grocery store companies accountable.](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/EMZ20P_FIN_E_20240601_V1S1?refcode=EMZ20P_FIN_E_20240606_V1S1_i1&t=10&akid=2197%2E4032634%2EdxaLCJ)**
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

These actions from the administration would complement my Price Gouging Prevention Act and Shrinkflation Prevention Act with Senator Bob Casey, which would crack down on corporate price gouging across the board. Look, families are identifying the cost of food and groceries as the top issue they've been facing. The federal government should use every possible tool to lower food prices — whether that’s by passing legislation or using the authority of federal departments. name: David Hogg
subject: Nervous about 2024
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
At this moment, all the polling says we are going to lose in most of our key battlegrounds.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240606&t=1&akid=776%2E587540%2E3OiUfM)
Peter,
I’m nervous about the 2024 election. 😱
Right now, all the non polling indicators are telling us Biden should win in November:
* **Democratic candidates are winning their races** – For example, our candidate, Nadarius Clark, won in one of the most competitive seats in Virginia.
* **Democrats are raising more money** – Trump's total number of donors is down while Biden’s are up from 2020. Plus, NPR reported that Biden had significantly outraised Trump at the end of Q3. (The gap is closing though, with the Trump campaign reporting a record haul after his criminal conviction.)
* **The midterms were not nearly as bad as predicted** – Democrats kept the Senate at the federal level, but we also made major gains in state legislatures around the country.
* **The stock market is up** – when the stock market has gone up in the three months before the election that _typically_ means the incumbent will win again – and we're on track for that to happen.

Despite these positive signs, at this moment, all the polling says we are **going to lose in most of our key battlegrounds.** Not good, Peter. 👎
Here’s something we know to be true: polls aren’t always accurate. But we still look at polls because they give us a sense as to how competitive an election could get.
One thing’s for certain: this presidential election is _extremely_ consequential and we have a real fight on our hands.
Leaders We Deserve is doing everything we can to elect young leaders across the country, and just as importantly, to diversify the strategy for Biden’s reelection by turning out progressive Democratic voters in swing districts that could determine the outcome of the presidential election in November.
Our goal is to be able to say that we left no stone unturned, put in every minute of our time, and supplied every resource we can think of to ensure the election goes the way countless Americans _need_ it to. There’s **far too much on the line** to leave this to chance.
If you are feeling as nervous as I am, I hope I can convince you to turn that anxiety into action. Our slate of endorsed candidates, all Gen Z or Millennials who refuse corporate contributions and focus on a progressive agenda, are working to inspire voter turnout in pivotal districts and help lift Biden to victory. **[Will you make a $5 donation to send resources to a swing race in a swing district right now to elect the next generation of leadership and stop a second Trump term?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240606?refcode=em20240606&amount=5&refcode2=776_587540_3OiUfM&akid=776%2E587540%2E3OiUfM)**

👉While the odds might be stacked against us, **YOU** have the power to turn things around.
Let’s turn our collective anxiety about this election into actions that can’t be ignored.
Thank you!!
David Hogg

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

Yesterday, I found out that Joe Biden is old. 🫨
#
Derek,
Yesterday, I found out that Joe Biden is old. 🫨
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240606?refcode=em20240606-9080&refcode2=9080_434096_XJz0cn&akid=9080%2E434096%2EXJz0cn)
Despite that absolute bombshell, **I am 💯 percent Team Joe.**
I mean, I’d only be concerned about Joe’s wellness if he was unable to stay awake during a criminal trial for bribing a former porn star while his wife was pregnant.
We need to rally our full support behind Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. Anything less is a vote for the other guy. **[In that spirit, will you rush a split $5 contribution to make sure President Biden serves a second term in the White House?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240606?refcode=em20240606-9080&refcode2=9080_434096_XJz0cn&akid=9080%2E434096%2EXJz0cn)**

Joe Biden has my support because if the other guy wins, we might as well get ready for a sulfuric 2nd term of chaos, revenge and division. Frankly, we don’t need that now – _or ever_.
**[Today, I hope you will join me in supporting Joe Biden’s campaign to get re-elected to the Presidency in November by making a $5 donation right now.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240606?refcode=em20240606-9080&refcode2=9080_434096_XJz0cn&akid=9080%2E434096%2EXJz0cn)**

❤️ John

The states set laws about whether felons lose their voting rights and how they can regain them, serving as a stark reminder of the disparities in voting rights for convicted felons in the United States. In , including New York, felons lose their right to vote only while incarcerated. People leaving prison in Florida, Alabama, and Arizona must pay all fines before they can cast a vote, and in (Virginia, Iowa, Tennessee, and Kentucky) they NEVER regain the right to vote. New York allows felons to vote unless they are incarcerated at the time of the election. Florida follows the law of the state in which the conviction took place. Unless Trump is in prison on Election Day, he will be allowed to vote. Wade_ and the raft of attacks on reproductive freedom that have come since this radical holding. The Supreme Court opted to constrain reproductive freedom in frightening and dangerous ways, striking a blow to our basic constitutional rights of liberty, privacy, and equality – which is why the American people overwhelmingly oppose the decision. **Republican leaders have promised that they will seek a nationwide abortion ban if they take over Congress in November. This is what we are up against this fall, and it is why the work of NOW PAC and their endorsed candidates is so important today.** I will continue to fight hard to keep abortion safe and legal here in Washington and codify abortion rights nationwide in federal law. Last fall, I joined a majority in the House to pass the Women's Health Protection Act, which would do exactly that, but it is currently being blocked by Republicans in the Senate. Like so many of you, I continue to be outraged by the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade and the raft of attacks on reproductive freedom that have come since this radical holding. | Peter,

If you need your appendix removed, do you have to justify your decision to the government? How about when your medical provider recommends a mammogram? Should they be required to pry into irrelevant details about your private life and report that personal information to the government?

A Kansas law, set to take effect July 1, requires health care providers to do just that when patients are seeking abortion care. It's a violation of patient privacy, jeopardizes provider-patient relationships—[**and we're fighting back.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86391896/477752084/1859933966?sourceid=1149647&utm_campaign=24emfr062406aaa&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=fye&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjMwZWFlYS0yNjI0LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UkaPdVup9_ojLdLu_cGIlgC3EJtwN9mgVQ_qIVQUN2M=&emci=9999e3e4-2624-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=0b30eaea-2624-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=954237) | [**SUPPORT THIS FIGHT**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86391902/477752091/1859933966?sourceid=1149647&utm_campaign=24emfr062406aaa&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=fye&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjMwZWFlYS0yNjI0LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UkaPdVup9_ojLdLu_cGIlgC3EJtwN9mgVQ_qIVQUN2M=&emci=9999e3e4-2624-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=0b30eaea-2624-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=954237 "SUPPORT THIS FIGHT")

The law, HB 2749, requires health care providers to interrogate patients seeking abortion care with invasive and unnecessary questions, including probing the "reasons" they are seeking an abortion. The Center for Reproductive Rights and Planned Parenthood are asking the court to add claims against HB 2749 to an ongoing case brought on behalf of Kansas abortion providers.

[**The decision to have an abortion is deeply personal—no one should be forced to tell the government why they are making that decision.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86391903/477752092/1859933966?sourceid=1149647&utm_campaign=24emfr062406aaa&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=fye&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjMwZWFlYS0yNjI0LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UkaPdVup9_ojLdLu_cGIlgC3EJtwN9mgVQ_qIVQUN2M=&emci=9999e3e4-2624-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=0b30eaea-2624-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=954237) It's frankly frightening that the state of Kansas is attempting to collect this type of private information, and unclear how it will be used.

The Center is committed to protecting the privacy and constitutional rights of Kansans and people fleeing states where abortion is banned to seek care elsewhere. Your support is CRITICAL to our work. Every bit of progress we make is because of you—[**and thanks to a special match your gift today will go 6X AS FAR, up to $150,000.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86391907/477752096/1859933966?sourceid=1149647&utm_campaign=24emfr062406aaa&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=fye&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjMwZWFlYS0yNjI0LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UkaPdVup9_ojLdLu_cGIlgC3EJtwN9mgVQ_qIVQUN2M=&emci=9999e3e4-2624-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=0b30eaea-2624-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=954237)

Alice Wang

President Biden and President Trump can’t stand up to the Military Industrial Complex and their allies in the DC bureaucracy. RFK Jr. can and will!
We need a President who is unafraid to challenge the Military Industrial Complex, the DC bureaucracy, and the politicians profiting off war. Friend,
This month marks the two-year anniversary of the Dobbs decision, the Supreme Court ruling that overturned Roe v. Wade.
Roe protected a woman's right to make intensely personal decisions about her own body and future. Without it, access to basic reproductive healthcare is under attack— services like birth control, IVF, and more.
Everyone should have the freedom to start a family on their own terms. But right now, whether you have that freedom or not depends on the state where you live.
That’s why yesterday, I voted for the Right to Contraception Act.
This bill would safeguard access to birth control across the country, superseding any state laws that ban contraception and protecting against future Supreme Court rulings that roll this right back.
Unfortunately, Senate Republicans killed it on the floor.
The American people deserve leaders who will fight for their fundamental rights and stand up for their freedom, not cave to extreme interests.
I won’t stop fighting for reproductive rights. This fall, I’m working to elect pro-choice Democrats in key seats around the country, so we’ll have the votes to get this done. Will you help me by chipping in now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_060624_Contraception_act]

body: 96  Team, Today, we commemorate the 80th anniversary of the invasion of Normandy, D-Day. We remember the American and Allied troops who stormed the beaches to liberate Europe from Nazi oppression, and to protect freedom around the world. https://www.facebook.com/drreddyks/videos/351183961008603/ I recorded a quick video talking about this important anniversary earlier today, which you can watch here or below. https://www.facebook.com/drreddyks/videos/351183961008603/ I’m reflecting on General Dwight Eisenhower’s (a great Kansan) Order of the Day. Here is an excerpt: “You are about to embark upon the Great Crusade, toward which we have striven these many months. The eyes of the world are upon you. The hope and prayers of liberty-loving people everywhere march with you. In company with our brave Allies and brothers-in-arms on other Fronts, you will bring about the destruction of the German war machine, the elimination of Nazi tyranny over the oppressed peoples of Europe, and security for ourselves in a free world.” So many of the soldiers who took part in that day made the ultimate sacrifice, and we must never forget them. This week, six For Country Caucus Members will lead a jump over Normandy in a WWII-era C-47, to commemorate the 80th Anniversary of the D-Day invasion. They spoke about the experience of this jump and previous ones like the one on the 75th Anniversary in [this segment on CBS Mornings](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=d5659c62ae&e=33f53a5b1a).

subject: We must protect our service members

body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]
Friend,

On October 25, 2023, a lone gunman attacked and killed eighteen people at a bowling alley and a nearby bar and grill in Lewiston, Maine, before taking his own life. The shooter was a grenade instructor for the Army Reserve. After his death, an examination of his brain found that he had extensive brain damage [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/03/06/us/maine-shooting-brain-injury.html] seen in veterans subjected to repeated weapons blasts.

This is a huge problem.

Blast overpressure occurs when the pressure from a shock wave damages the brain by moving it inside the skull. It accounts for more than half of all traumatic brain injuries [https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC4255273/] (TBI) in veterans and active service members.

During just three months in 2023, the Department of Defense provided treatment to service members over 50,000 times for traumatic brain injuries.

Sign if you agree: Congress must take steps to protect our service members from the effects of blast overpressure. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/blast-overpressure-petition?contactdata=WIa/fY7/ghKF7PiaETPZlrT9aFvJ3ErwFYJb2v2OR67r3nhyWwlFKzajn4laYnqGzakoNwDOypGXcR9M2HcTfsP0xhcYpB4xNXYKP0eWOjuVJ4pjRDVw5lGsDZTBjhPSH81f49Y++pZzDDTPQwrOIA==]

Sign the Petition [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/blast-overpressure-petition?contactdata=WIa/fY7/ghKF7PiaETPZlrT9aFvJ3ErwFYJb2v2OR67r3nhyWwlFKzajn4laYnqGzakoNwDOypGXcR9M2HcTfsP0xhcYpB4xNXYKP0eWOjuVJ4pjRDVw5lGsDZTBjhPSH81f49Y++pZzDDTPQwrOIA==]

The Pentagon has admitted that its safety standards regarding blast overpressure aren’t based on scientific evidence [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/04/09/us/pentagon-blast-exposure-brain-elizabeth-warren-joni-ernst.html] . Soldiers who should be safe by these standards have suffered traumatic brain injuries that irrevocably altered their behavior, causing hallucinations, seizures, depression, and thoughts of suicide. Nearly one in five post-9/11 veterans [https://www.hsrd.research.va.gov/publications/inprogress/june22/default.cfm?InProgressMenu=june22-5] suffers from a traumatic brain injury, yet the Defense Department has done little to protect service members from lasting damage.

That’s why I’m working with Senator Elizabeth Warren, Senator Joni Ernst, and Representative Elise Stefanik to pass the Blast Overpressure Safety Act. This bill would take several steps to hold the Defense Department accountable for the health of our soldiers and veterans, including:

* Requiring an outside audit by the Government Accountability Office to detail what the DoD is doing to address the risks of blast exposure;
* Monitoring service members’ brain health through regular neurocognitive assessments, as well as blast overpressure exposure and TBI logs; and
* Enhancing efforts to mitigate exposure when acquiring new weapons and help service members affected to blast exposure access care.

We owe it to our men and women in uniform to address the dangers of blast overpressure and take action based on the evidence we have.

Tell Congress to pass the Blast Overpressure Safety Act. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/blast-overpressure-petition?contactdata=WIa/fY7/ghKF7PiaETPZlrT9aFvJ3ErwFYJb2v2OR67r3nhyWwlFKzajn4laYnqGzakoNwDOypGXcR9M2HcTfsP0xhcYpB4xNXYKP0eWOjuVJ4pjRDVw5lGsDZTBjhPSH81f49Y++pZzDDTPQwrOIA==]

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

Wait! One more thing–

Ro doesn't accept a cent from lobbyists or PACs, meaning our work is completely funded by grassroots supporters like you. By donating just $3 today, you’re helping us create a country that works for everyone, not just those at the top. That means a renewed investment in American manufacturing, Medicare for All, student debt relief, and a green future.

If you want to support our people-powered campaign as we continue to fight for progress in Washington, please consider making a donation of $3 or more today. Thank you!

clean_body: [] Friend, On October 25, 2023, a lone gunman attacked and killed eighteen people at a bowling alley and a nearby bar and grill in Lewiston, Maine, before taking his own life. The shooter was a grenade instructor for the Army Reserve. After his death, an examination of his brain found that he had extensive brain damage [] seen in veterans subjected to repeated weapons blasts. This is a huge problem. Blast overpressure occurs when the pressure from a shock wave damages the brain by moving it inside the skull. It accounts for more than half of all traumatic brain injuries [] (TBI) in veterans and active service members. During just three months in 2023, the Department of Defense provided treatment to service members over 50,000 times for traumatic brain injuries. Sign if you agree: Congress must take steps to protect our service members from the effects of blast overpressure. [==] Sign the Petition [==] The Pentagon has admitted that its safety standards regarding blast overpressure aren’t based on scientific evidence [] . Soldiers who should be safe by these standards have suffered traumatic brain injuries that irrevocably altered their behavior, causing hallucinations, seizures, depression, and thoughts of suicide. Nearly one in five post-9/11 veterans [] suffers from a traumatic brain injury, yet the Defense Department has done little to protect service members from lasting damage. That’s why I’m working with Senator Elizabeth Warren, Senator Joni Ernst, and Representative Elise Stefanik to pass the Blast Overpressure Safety Act. This bill would take several steps to hold the Defense Department accountable for the health of our soldiers and veterans, including: Requiring an outside audit by the Government Accountability Office to detail what the DoD is doing to address the risks of blast exposure; Monitoring service members’ brain health through regular neurocognitive assessments, as well as blast overpressure exposure and TBI logs; and * Enhancing efforts to mitigate exposure when acquiring new weapons and help service members affected to blast exposure access care. We owe it to our men and women in uniform to address the dangers of blast overpressure and take action based on the evidence we have. Tell Congress to pass the Blast Overpressure Safety Act. [==] Thank you for your activism and all that you do. In solidarity, Ro Wait! One more thing– Ro doesn't accept a cent from lobbyists or PACs, meaning our work is completely funded by grassroots supporters like you. With the Colorado primary in less than 50 days, I asked Chris if I could share an important message:

I don’t like people fighting my battles for me.

It’s something I learned serving as a Captain with the Army Rangers. As a leader, you are expected to lead by example and put service above self. That meant I was the first person to jump out of a plane, and the last person to eat. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86394920/477759907/1715439250?refcode=email_060624_crowsplit&amounts=10,20,50,100,250,250&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OGJhNTM4OS0yYTI0LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KvfgosqoDUJukHD2-TmSg8V-nGP4EPCHgoGg_Cl6SSk=) Even as I rose up the ranks, I always remembered what it was like to walk in the boots of a private.

**This is why I ran for Congress in the first place.**

When I saw Donald Trump and extreme MAGA loyalists refuse to take action on issues like gun violence and protecting reproductive rights, I said enough is enough. I never thought about running for Congress, but we desperately needed a new generation of leadership to step up.

Media pundits and our opponent doubted our chances — but we made our voices heard loud and clear on Election Night. **Grassroots support helped me defeat a four-term incumbent and become the first Democrat to represent Colorado’s 6th District.**

But the truth is, the fight isn’t over. Democracy, civility, and women’s rights are on the ballot this November. The stakes could not be higher. My time in combat taught me to never back down from a fight, and I don’t intend to stop now.

---
| Today, Governor Scott **vetoed** the Legislature’s historic, double digit property tax increase bill.

Here was part of his message: _Vermonters cannot afford a double-digit property tax increase. Especially while facing a historic eight-percent property tax increase last year, a 20% increase in DMV fees, a new payroll tax taking effect July 1, increased fuel costs to heat homes and businesses from the Clean Heat Standard, and increased electric costs if my veto of the Renewable Energy Standard is not sustained. All on top of several years of inflation – the most regressive tax of all – driving up the cost of household essentials like food, clothing and services faster than paychecks are growing.

We must provide property tax relief now. This can’t wait for another study before implementing cost containment strategies. We must also reform our education funding formula to ensure sustainable spending growth and equitable opportunities, and prioritize funding educational opportunities that improve outcomes by reinvesting in the strategies that best serve kids over maintaining the status quo._

The Governor tried to work with lawmakers to prevent this unacceptable tax hike, but they moved forward anyway. They will be convening on June 17 to attempt to override the Governor’s vetoes. **We need your help to elect more legislators who agree that Vermonters have had enough and simply cannot afford to see their costs go up anywhere near this rate. ** Sincerely, Team Scott

Hi Friend, it’s Team Brad Pfaff reaching out.
A lot is at stake in this election, and we had to make sure you knew why it’s so important to protect Brad’s seat.
We cannot afford to lose the 32nd Senate District to a far-right extremist.
We are about to get into all the anti-Wisconsin things that Brad’s far-right opponent stands for but if you can’t stay that long – do you think you could pitch in any amount today to support Brad’s pro-democracy, pro-working class grassroots campaign? SUPPORT BRAD [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20240607_em_fr_b1_BP_NGP]
Friend, Brad’s far-right opponent does not represent Wisconsin’s values of integrity, empathy, and respect. In the past few months, she has:
❌ supported policies that would let polluters off the hook for contaminating our water with PFAS
❌ written an opinion piece where she advocated for lowering taxes for the ultra rich, which would shift the tax burden to hardworking Wisconsinites
❌ stated that she’s proudly anti-choice and has written in support of restrictions on reproductive rights
Brad's opponent isn't in this race to help farmers and working families – she’s only challenging Sen. Pfaff after dropping out of her original race for Wisconsin's U.S. Senate seat.
Our community deserves a State Senator who will vote with the needs of Wisconsinites in mind.
Friend, we cannot risk losing District 32 to a far-right extremist who is anti-environment, anti-reproductive freedoms, and anti-working Wisconsin families. There is no time to waste — will you join Brad’s coalition with a donation of any amount today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20240607_em_fr_b1_BP_NGP]
SAVE DISTRICT 32 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20240607_em_fr_b1_BP_NGP]
Thank you,
Sen. Brad Pfaff
Brad Pfaff is a proud son of the rolling hills, coulees, and valleys of northern La Crosse County where he was raised on his family's dairy farm. It was 2009. I was stationed at the Al Taqaddum Airbase where I was a Marine Captain leading a police training team. Twelve Marines and a Navy Corpsman. Running missions through Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Ramadi.
It was my first of three tours of duty during the War on Terror. And from our camp, the base's burn pit loomed over us.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/801c91df-1177-4db4-a2e5-3630662412c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Smoke columns filled the sky and blew through our living space. We ran through it, joking about how we should be doing gas mask runs. For three months that pit bathed us in toxic fumes. We accepted it and focused on our duty.
For me, that was planning our routes and poring over intel to avoid the immediate danger: IEDs on all the convoys and missions we were running outside the wire. I was so proud to bring every member of that team home safely.
**Or so I thought -- because, as it turns out, we couldn't protect ourselves from our own country.**
When I got back from Iraq, I developed a persistent tickle in my throat. Constant irritation. I never had allergies before and annoyed myself with the constant throat clearing. Eventually, I was so embarrassed by it that I went to the base clinic. They said it was postnasal drip and that they could give me allergy medicine. There was no formal diagnosis. But over 10 years later, it's still there.
Bothersome. Uncomfortable, but certainly manageable. And that's about the best story you'll hear about a vet who's been exposed to burn pits. Many struggle with chronic respiratory issues. Migraines. Cancer.
So imagine how we all felt, watching country club politicians like Josh Hawley, most of whom have never even worn the uniform, throw us a giant middle finger by voting to stall the PACT Act**** -- legislation that expanded healthcare coverage for veterans who were exposed to these toxic pits.
Hawley's ultimate vote for the legislation came after substantial public backlash from his actions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0df5720f-eef5-4e0a-b33e-ca17288a668a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
As it turns out, Hawley's politics kept [over a million](https://substack.com/redirect/79a5c432-5b9d-433c-83f9-d9d4e6278129?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) veterans waiting to get help.
What Hawley did was about as anti-American as it gets. Patriots don't attack veterans who suffered injuries or illness from serving their country. At a time when veterans needed Hawley to set aside politics, he failed.
Washington spent years voting to keep us in these forever wars, lying to the American people about what was really going on over there, and getting rich off their defense contractor stocks that skyrocket when we're at war.
These people profited off of sending us over there only to screw us when we came back messed up.**** It's criminal -- and I'm ready to do something about it.****
I served my country for 13 years in the United States Marine Corps. I'd give anything for this country. And I won't let my fellow veterans keep waiting for politicians like Josh Hawley to stand up and do their jobs.
This election is our only chance to hold Hawley accountable for running out on veterans.
I only wish our leaders could make an ounce of the sacrifice that our veterans have.
Our country would be a better place.

Trump was convicted on 34 felony counts. We can’t just move on.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86397663/477767184/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDE0NzgyYzUtMmUyNC1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=JouPUR5qmaBTTyfHsguI8NTB9C5Y5yje81V3Jj77cs0=&emci=b4551cbf-2e24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=014782c5-2e24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
It’s been _just one week_ since Trump was convicted of 34 felonies. Here’s what’s happened since:
* Fox News and Republicans are spreading conspiracy theories and smearing the justice system while violent threats are exploding on right-wing websites.
* Trump raised $53 million in the 24 hours following the verdict, crashing his fundraising website and giving him the biggest fundraising month in campaign history.
* The mainstream media is already moving on, with more coverage devoted to guessing how Trump’s conviction will impact his poll numbers than covering his crimes or the trial itself.

[**We’ll tell you what Jon Stewart said about the media on this week’s _Daily Show_ in a moment, but if you’re ready to help COURIER provide rigorous, truthful journalism to communities who need it most, can you chip in $20 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86397667/477767189/-593472309?refcode=20240606-EM-TrumpUpdate&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDE0NzgyYzUtMmUyNC1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=JouPUR5qmaBTTyfHsguI8NTB9C5Y5yje81V3Jj77cs0=)
On Monday’s _Daily Show_ , Jon Stewart took the media to task for their coverage of Trump’s trial.
**This image pretty accurately sums up how he was feeling:**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86397672/477767192/-593472309?refcode=20240606-EM-TrumpUpdate&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDE0NzgyYzUtMmUyNC1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=JouPUR5qmaBTTyfHsguI8NTB9C5Y5yje81V3Jj77cs0=)
After showing a clip of _Fox News_ journalists uncritically letting Trump deny saying "lock her up" about Hillary Clinton in 2016, Stewart went into a long rant about why our news media is so broken right now.
**His core argument is that there aren't "two Americas" or "alternative facts," just the truth. The news media's role is to report out facts so the public can discern the truth, not to speculate and create a "horse race" for ratings and profits during elections—or, in the case of right-wing media like _Fox News_ , ignore facts altogether to push propaganda just to get Trump elected.**
Two things:
**First** , Jon Stewart is a national treasure and isn’t it awesome that he’s back! ❤️❤️❤️
**Second** , we couldn’t agree more with what he says about the purpose of the media. That’s why our ten battleground state newsrooms are on the ground in this critical election year providing factual, rigorous reporting about the issues that matter most in the communities we serve.
We don’t do “both sides” or useless horse race coverage just to drive clicks and make a buck, and, thanks to your grassroots support, we make all of our content freely available in the communities we serve.
[**Because we don’t charge a subscription fee or put our news behind a paywall, we rely on the generosity of supporters like you to continue and report out the truth during this critical year for our country. So, Peter, can you chip in $20 so we can ensure our newsrooms have everything they need to do their important work?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86397677/477767199/-593472309?refcode=20240606-EM-TrumpUpdate&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDE0NzgyYzUtMmUyNC1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=JouPUR5qmaBTTyfHsguI8NTB9C5Y5yje81V3Jj77cs0=)

clean_body: Trump was convicted on 34 felony counts. We can’t just move on. Peter, It’s been just one week since Trump was convicted of 34 felonies. Here’s what’s happened since: Fox News and Republicans are spreading conspiracy theories and smearing the justice system while violent threats are exploding on right-wing websites. Trump raised $53 million in the 24 hours following the verdict, crashing his fundraising website and giving him the biggest fundraising month in campaign history. The mainstream media is already moving on, with more coverage devoted to guessing how Trump’s conviction will impact his poll numbers than covering his crimes or the trial itself. = On Monday’s Daily Show , Jon Stewart took the media to task for their coverage of Trump’s trial. This image pretty accurately sums up how he was feeling: = After showing a clip of Fox News journalists uncritically letting Trump deny saying "lock her up" about Hillary Clinton in 2016, Stewart went into a long rant about why our news media is so broken right now. His core argument is that there aren't "two Americas" or "alternative facts," just the truth. The news media's role is to report out facts so the public can discern the truth, not to speculate and create a "horse race" for ratings and profits during elections—or, in the case of right-wing media like Fox News , ignore facts altogether to push propaganda just to get Trump elected. Two things: First , Jon Stewart is a national treasure and isn’t it awesome that he’s back! ❤️❤️❤️ Second , we couldn’t agree more with what he says about the purpose of the media. That’s why our ten battleground state newsrooms are on the ground in this critical election year providing factual, rigorous reporting about the issues that matter most in the communities we serve. name: Jill Stein for President
subject: The Other Biden Ban: Pride
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
Biden implements anti-2SLGBTQIA+ Republican policy

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=the_other_bidenban&n=1)
---
Peter, Just a few weeks ago, President Biden issued a [statement](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=umrg49VoY2cmSSgK2JW4WvH3idwXiLgOnEW5UjfGc-Q7_EyOP3VG6qCYKfRWB8Od5LOuIewfRLuRexJ_3bbSlDZr9stNqsa5ftvmH0shB-iMyrqnLB3HGgzhEyWh6KbCEoDX1xEC2naK9g8pfB8ANJ2fU1qBZBS3iiqRO4-Sj_T2V4PrCWYzatF7gH0xCWMf7t-4mTlmceXWLhsh4f2tO_xC579KCyizW84gmXyCVz92A7Gkn8gWcmiAA4uyR7Zo&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=the_other_bidenban&n=2) “Marking International Day Against Homophobia, Transphobia and Biphobia" where he said the following. ** __**_“Like all human beings, LGBTQI+ people deserve equality – equal rights, equal citizenship, equal dignity. It is our shared moral responsibility to fight back against homophobia, biphobia, and transphobia, just as we must fight back against all hate-fueled violence, at home and abroad.”_** __** Equal rights.

Equal citizenship. Equal dignity.

**__**At home and abroad.**_

_**That sounds beautiful. It sounds like what you want the President to say and believe.

---
#### _**However, when it comes to protecting human rights here at home and abroad we can’t just listen to what the current president says, we have to watch what he does.**_
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=eG6MrFdwke3mCkFDV566Bz4ky1KfVIvLvoUwnvJV17dO45TonjxDq-vdllsqnPSPbbjELBnawhyGpulTG5rIIbZ2fL2yQcrmhPXPDISH8FEdCbnbGe-imceyvXoSvY_HShDOahqhsixgUOrqcMf_spJK_b8CFonFAs6GvVC90xASrJkUNfktnaUK5rbVcD2c&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=the_other_bidenban&n=3)
---
This Bloomberg [headline](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=eG6MrFdwke3mCkFDV566Bz4ky1KfVIvLvoUwnvJV17dO45TonjxDq-vdllsqnPSPbbjELBnawhyGpulTG5rIIbZ2fL2yQcrmhPXPDISH8FEdCbnbGe-imceyvXoSvY_HShDOahqhsixgUOrqcMf_spJK_b8CFonFAs6GvVC90xASrJkUNfktnaUK5rbVcD2c&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=the_other_bidenban&n=4) from March shows us what Biden believes.

He believes that representation for some Americans is transactional. While banning the pride flag at US embassies may seem harmless to some. This policy decision is a reflection of a greater threat facing our nation.

That threat comes from Joe Biden and his long career of using American minorities of all backgrounds for his political gain.

The question is what did Joe Biden get in exchange for signing into law a Republican policy seeking to erase 2SLGBTQIA+ Americans?

A 1.2 trillion dollar Republican endorsed budget [deal](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=8XkgFoFemjG3W8ZeG5lzuQmsSTfm3bUsUfgTZsD8Bgw6E0cGtgRyLiChZINlz-kIhzFKk2NzT_fsH0MiCJheYsF7y9scVT3NQIj4OxBpw30s7CUjaMJH0vRe5T7R4rMQ-Lzg7NAcKFDmzNMPRurLFA&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=the_other_bidenban&n=5), 886 billion of which went to the Department of Defense.

Now more than ever we need a president in the White House that will defend 2SLGBTQIA+ rights - not erase them.

If you agree, will you help us power this movement for people, planet, and peace over profits by making a contribution today?
---

Peter —

In just a moment I am going to ask you to split a $25 contribution to my
campaign for U.S. Senate in Arizona with Angela Alsobrooks in Maryland.
Please, give me a chance to explain why this request is so important.

Here it goes:

Trump is going to have a town hall in North Phoenix today, later this
afternoon. It’s his first visit to Arizona since 2022. It’s his first
major public appearance since he was charged with 34 felonies last week.
And it’s a huge sign of how important Arizona is to his re-election.

The GOP has seen a massive increase in their fundraising since Trump’s
verdict last week. The Trump campaign took in more than $140 million in
May, with $70 million coming in the 48 hours after that verdict. Kari Lake
is sure to be raking in the cash right now, too.

That couldn’t possibly happen at a worse time for us. June is an official
FEC deadline month, and once we hit that deadline we’re legally required
to report our numbers. It is critical that we show strength.

But while Trump and Kari Lake are filling their coffers, we’re emptying
ours. We’re spending millions right now, but our fundraising continues to
slow down. If we don’t pick up the pace we are in serious trouble.

Trump and Lake will do whatever they can to win Arizona. That’s why he’s
coming to Phoenix, and it’s why he’ll probably attack me directly this
afternoon. He’s got to tear down my campaign to win this state.

So, I need your help. I need a huge fundraising day today, and I need you

really.

---
Fellow Conservative,

On Tuesday evening, Republican primary voters in Montana formally nominated me to be the Republican U.S. Senate candidate in Montana.

With this great honor comes great responsibility. _**It’s now up to me to take on and take down one of the most slippery politicians serving the American public in any capacity.**_

Peter,
I went to a high school graduation last week in the small town where I grew up.

Everyone stood and showed respect for the national anthem...
...and then for the police, firefighters, and veterans in attendance...
...and then for the graduates leaving high school for military service.

**It reminded me of everything good about America -- the things we should be talking about more on the nightly news.**

Unfortunately, it also reminded me of something we all know to be true: **The people and the values that make America great have been forgotten**

body:
There’s no right or wrong answer.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86404119/477788020/1328794144?refcode=ea.2a8b330c-3b24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.2a8b330c-3b24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJhOGIzMzBjLTNiMjQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0G-Kw1K9YKkdnF2DJ3bPJ2ibfx3F5q04kcI5BsHa6BU=&emci=268b330c-3b24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=2a8b330c-3b24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)
---
My whole life has been marked by epiphanies made through books. One of my most memorable reads was _Green Mansions_ by William Henry Hudson when I was just 12. It was the first time I remember losing myself in the story completely, but it wouldn’t be the last. Books have this amazing ability to shape our views, fuel our passions, and sometimes even change our lives. For me, _On Fire: A Burning Case for a Green New Deal_ by Naomi Klein was the spark that ignited my urgency for climate activism. I moved to Washington D.C. and started Fire Drill Fridays, a weekly protest for climate action. This journey inspired me to write my own book, _What Can I Do? My Path from Climate Despair to Action._ I truly believe that every book you read has the potential to profoundly change the way you see the world. **[So, I want to hear from you: What books have impacted your life, inspired your activism, or just allowed you to escape in the pages?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86404120/477788021/1311544971?refcode=ea.2a8b330c-3b24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.2a8b330c-3b24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJhOGIzMzBjLTNiMjQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0G-Kw1K9YKkdnF2DJ3bPJ2ibfx3F5q04kcI5BsHa6BU=&emci=268b330c-3b24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=2a8b330c-3b24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)** | [**TELL JANE ABOUT YOUR FAVORITE BOOKS 📚**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86404121/477788022/1311544971?refcode=ea.2a8b330c-3b24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.2a8b330c-3b24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJhOGIzMzBjLTNiMjQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0G-Kw1K9YKkdnF2DJ3bPJ2ibfx3F5q04kcI5BsHa6BU=&emci=268b330c-3b24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=2a8b330c-3b24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)
---
Whether it’s a groundbreaking scientific work, an inspiring personal story, or a compelling call to action, I’d love to know what’s captured your interest lately.
I believe that sharing our reading experiences can bring us closer and make our efforts even stronger. Who knows? Your recommendations could even inspire others in our community to pick up a new book and deepen their understanding and commitment to our cause.
Books have always been my refuge and my guide, and I’m eager to see what’s been inspiring you. Don’t be shy; there’s no right or wrong answer. **[Click here to tell me what you’re reading and why it matters to you.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86404122/477788023/1311544971?refcode=ea.2a8b330c-3b24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.2a8b330c-3b24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJhOGIzMzBjLTNiMjQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0G-Kw1K9YKkdnF2DJ3bPJ2ibfx3F5q04kcI5BsHa6BU=&emci=268b330c-3b24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=2a8b330c-3b24-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)**
Your voice, your stories, and yes, your book recommendations, are what keep our movement vibrant and resilient.

clean_body: There’s no right or wrong answer. | My whole life has been marked by epiphanies made through books. One of my most memorable reads was Green Mansions by William Henry Hudson when I was just 12. It was the first time I remember losing myself in the story completely, but it wouldn’t be the last. Books have this amazing ability to shape our views, fuel our passions, and sometimes even change our lives. For me, On Fire: A Burning Case for a Green New Deal by Naomi Klein was the spark that ignited my urgency for climate activism. I moved to Washington D.C. and started Fire Drill Fridays, a weekly protest for climate action. This journey inspired me to write my own book, What Can I Do? My Path from Climate Despair to Action. I truly believe that every book you read has the potential to profoundly change the way you see the world. | Whether it’s a groundbreaking scientific work, an inspiring personal story, or a compelling call to action, I’d love to know what’s captured your interest lately. I believe that sharing our reading experiences can bring us closer and make our efforts even stronger. Who knows? Your recommendations could even inspire others in our community to pick up a new book and deepen their understanding and commitment to our cause. Books have always been my refuge and my guide, and I’m eager to see what’s been inspiring you. Don’t be shy; there’s no right or wrong answer. Your voice, your stories, and yes, your book recommendations, are what keep our movement vibrant and resilient. It's June, so that means we're right around the corner from our important Federal Election Commission deadline: On June 30th, we have an "end-of-quarter" deadline closing our “Q2,” which is the second quarter of the election year.

This will be the last FEC fundraising deadline before the Republican National Convention, beginning on July 15, and before we learn who our Republican opponent will be ahead of the primary on August 6th. It’s also the first deadline since we launched our TV and digital ads.

So it's a biggie. The most important of the campaign to date.

subject: Can we explain?
body:
Here’s why we’re reaching out:
#
Hey,
You’re going to get a lot of fundraising emails (like this one!) over the next few weeks.
**There’s a good reason for that, too. Something big is coming up.**
June 30 is a really important end-of-quarter fundraising deadline for most political campaigns — but it’s especially crucial for ours. **It’s our final end-of-quarter deadline before the primary.**
After the June 30 deadline, our campaign is required to submit a public fundraising report to the Federal Elections Commission (FEC). This report will show our supporters and opponents the strength of our movement heading into the primary election on September 10.
**If we fail to post a strong report that shows we can win in September AND November, it could encourage right-wing super PACs and special interests to dump money into trying to defeat us.**
That’s why we’re reaching out to ask you for your support before the FEC report is due.
[**Can you make a $5 contribution ahead of this big moment for our campaign?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240606-1?refcode=em20240606-1-572&amount=5&refcode2=572_21716_tm4cMA&akid=572%2E21716%2Etm4cMA)_Every donation made before the clock strikes midnight on June 30 will be included in our next fundraising report._
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240606-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240606-1-572&refcode2=572_21716_tm4cMA&akid=572%2E21716%2Etm4cMA)**
On top of our report being heavily scrutinized, we’re also making **significant budget decisions** with less than 100 days to go until our primary election — like booking TV ad time!
So between now and June 30 at 11:59 p.m. ET, our team is working incredibly hard to raise the money we need to send Sarah to Congress. And as a people-powered campaign, we're relying on the support of folks just like you to make it happen!
[**Right now, the most important thing you can do to help Sarah win is to donate to our campaign. Can you make a donation of $5 or any amount you can?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240606-1?refcode=em20240606-1-572&amount=5&refcode2=572_21716_tm4cMA&akid=572%2E21716%2Etm4cMA)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240606-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240606-1-572&refcode2=572_21716_tm4cMA&akid=572%2E21716%2Etm4cMA)**
Let’s do this!
Team McBride

| |
Dear Friend of Knowledge, Are you struggling with a difficult question in your life? Often, I find myself in that position as well. It's part of the human condition to be faced with difficult situations, choices, and people. We teach at Hillsdale College that we must carefully consider concepts such as morality, ethics, happiness, courage, character, and justice when we face difficult questions. In the _Nicomachean Ethics_ --the first book written on how best to live--Aristotle argues that human happiness chiefly depends upon a person's character, which is formed by making good choices. But good choices don't come naturally. That's why every student at Hillsdale studies Aristotle. In fact, understanding Aristotle is so important to living a good life that we've produced our online course, **" Introduction to Aristotle's _Ethics_ : How to Lead a Good Life." **
---
| | And now you can own the course on DVD, along with a special Hillsdale College edition of Aristotle's _Nicomachean Ethics_ , for personal study. You'll not only study what Aristotle says about the good life with Hillsdale College President Larry P. Arnn, but you will also explore ways to put this knowledge to work.
---
| [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8c8968f40d644b8782fb7413f0c942c6&_e=MNlPSMmtsKrazqGp6IEy2lMshgpn7M9l5H9EkVTi3OzsjXYdSaz8KSYSK-A9U9kbfYVuTgbqC76lO3JIDAfdIieNCDsG5d2QslSIAPCLbo7tiIAN4uLnSUaaT-toizrimQKDur4guqDLHuU35RIQCW1rinvoGdEC6_OK8zRCUCU7ZjRqfrunn1gr3FIq8KFC5GqiLTBierLpGk21W6nhGXmcwfAOkOb6b22bkEVUdR4fyEQ4U9s-Hv2Tj36TWUy4V_fu9KK1Ka4iQrkYf_TTmE7JNZe15fWwrUjX9-mFypEfpxbpklceSrZTlOFoqUKjbslyQl2gPcwhgVNF0Rugm-FEm5Nb2lYSuoJo0d3ZE2Q19LnEAY4msRu5e1xbcyrx7VzUg_ki8kWIiSvM9FmHww%3D%3D)
---
| | The DVD gives you a seat at the table in a seminar-style class like those here on campus, and you'll read from the same book the students are in the course. In addition to the topics I've already mentioned, the course focuses on subjects including:
* Aristotle's _Politics_ and the Nature of Man
* Deliberation and Choice
* Practical Judgment
* Contemplation and Action

Just consider what Rebecca, a free online course student, recently said: _" I have learned [through the Aristotle course] that every choice we make etches into our soul."_ Make a good choice, and watch a special preview video of the course. Then reserve your DVD and book today using this secure link: [**_https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/aristotle-dvd-book-offer_**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8c8968f40d644b8782fb7413f0c942c6&_e=MNlPSMmtsKrazqGp6IEy2lMshgpn7M9l5H9EkVTi3OzsjXYdSaz8KSYSK-A9U9kbfYVuTgbqC76lO3JIDAfdIieNCDsG5d2QslSIAPCLbo7tiIAN4uLnSUaaT-toizrimQKDur4guqDLHuU35RIQCW1rinvoGdEC6_OK8zRCUCU7ZjRqfrunn1gr3FIq8KFC5GqiLTBierLpGk21W6nhGXmcwfAOkOb6b22bkEVUdR4fyEQ4U9s-Hv2Tj36TWUy4n_kU-GTn9AQ2q7OBh5BNHYB137cMNKAoOiIsHulLJM8UNly58k3t87s1uXOaohQrj0pY_XZXt6hijHXkjqVQrgJc0ZQjsNsY4PFA7IfUwz7zNGgy_ZLcelrz1EluD5TE6xryVBRAPeHOzeapLHoFww%3D%3D) After watching the preview, if you're struggling with a thorny question, I hope you'll join Rebecca and many others by reserving your DVD of [**" Introduction to Aristotle's _Ethics_ "**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8c8968f40d644b8782fb7413f0c942c6&_e=MNlPSMmtsKrazqGp6IEy2lMshgpn7M9l5H9EkVTi3OzsjXYdSaz8KSYSK-A9U9kbfYVuTgbqC76lO3JIDAfdIieNCDsG5d2QslSIAPCLbo7tiIAN4uLnSUaaT-toizrimQKDur4guqDLHuU35RIQCW1rinvoGdEC6_OK8zRCUCU7ZjRqfrunn1gr3FIq8KFC5GqiLTBierLpGk21W6nhGXmcwfAOkOb6b22bkEVUdR4qnVloTYfw1cy5voCvu8Xqz0PC2Mw5qcSMZE-9jse1mKA4jZdmnNynLP4_B8Xeeess6M5xZosqziUp00p60CO9kEA43RcglC9SEnXPVuAZU1wCSVgm8nAxsb_puHIY0UrKAPO3ke7n7RPnRK_jbGrnCtxkQyfqE8-M0L9F4uADjQ%3D%3D)**** along with its companion book __ today _._ Quantities of the DVD and book are limited, so don't wait too long to decide. disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Remember when Congress sanctioned Russia for spreading online
misinformation in the United States ahead of the 2020
election, Peter?

It turns out the Israeli government is currently doing something similar:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/sign/20240606_israel_misinformation/?source=em20240606-35162&akid=35162%2E1203867%2EKB1qS1 ]Tweet from Prem Thakker: Wow—New York Times & Haaretz report Israel
ordered a secret digital operation on US lawmakers (esp. Black Democrats)
that spread misinformation & anti-Arab sentiment and attacked
pro-Palestinian Americans, to sway public opinion & influence the
lawmakers to fund Israel’s military.

According to reports, the Israeli Ministry of Diaspora Affairs spent $2
million since October to create fake news websites and social media
accounts and used OpenAI and ChatGPT to create Islamophobic,
anti-Palestinian, and pro-war content. The accounts specifically targeted
Black Democratic lawmakers, including our own Rep. Cori Bush as well as
major AIPAC beneficiaries Rep. Ritchie Torres and House Minority Leader
Hakeem Jeffries.

It’s bad enough that the anti-Palestinian lobby group AIPAC, which is
mostly funded by corporate and Republican megadonors, is infiltrating our
Democratic primaries with hand-picked challengers to oust the Squad.

But this is a dangerous campaign of lies and misinformation carried out by
a foreign government. And it’s all the more disturbing that it's happening
while the U.S. continues to provide Israel’s military with billions of
dollars in taxpayer-funded weapons and bombs used to carry out genocide.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/sign/20240606_israel_misinformation/?source=em20240606-35162&akid=35162%2E1203867%2EKB1qS1 ]The Democratic Party was up in arms when Russia meddled in our
elections and held them accountable for it — we need that same energy NOW.
Will you sign on to our letter urging Congress to hold Israel accountable
for their U.S. misinformation campaign?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/sign/20240606_israel_misinformation/?source=em20240606-35162&akid=35162%2E1203867%2EKB1qS1 ]SIGN ON

The Democratic establishment cannot keep making excuses for the Israeli
government’s crimes. The more we can raise the alarm about this to our
representatives, the more likely we are to see real accountability.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20240606-35162-footer&t=1001&refcode2=35162_1203867_KB1qS1&akid=35162%2E1203867%2EKB1qS1

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1002&akid=35162%2E1203867%2EKB1qS1

* * *
## **All Our Hard Work Relies on Signatures**
**
** We've all put a lot of time and effort to get our party in the place we're in. This November, every Pennsylvanian can have at least 2 Forward Party candidates on their ballot and we can be a recognized Minor Party all across the state. Whether that happens or not depends on all of us collecting the signatures to get these candidates on the ballot. We are making great progress on our goal but could really use some more hands to spread the work. If you're looking for a way to help, this is a great way to talk to your neighbors and explain why we need something new in our politics. If you are not able to help as a Signature Gatherer, please reach out to your Regional Chair to make a plan to meet up and sign onto Papers for your county. Your signature alone helps us toward our goal. Ben- b8a8v1@yahoo.com Kristine- olliesmom2014@gmail.com

clean_body: This is how you build a new party | Convention in Gettysburg Thank you so much who took part in our 2024 Convention. We couldn't be more pleased with how it all came together. We had addresses from Candidates and guests and took care of some very important business. Most importantly, we were able to come together and add to the connections that will bring us success moving Forward. If you were not able to join, please check out the videos below. A lot of work went into making this convention a success and want to thank everyone that contributed their time and energy and also their funds. We have a lot more work to do this year but look forward to having another convention in 2025. All Our Hard Work Relies on Signatures We've all put a lot of time and effort to get our party in the place we're in. This November, every Pennsylvanian can have at least 2 Forward Party candidates on their ballot and we can be a recognized Minor Party all across the state. Whether that happens or not depends on all of us collecting the signatures to get these candidates on the ballot. We are making great progress on our goal but could really use some more hands to spread the work. If you're looking for a way to help, this is a great way to talk to your neighbors and explain why we need something new in our politics. If you are not able to help as a Signature Gatherer, please reach out to your Regional Chair to make a plan to meet up and sign onto Papers for your county. Your signature alone helps us toward our goal. Ben- b8a8v1@yahoo.com Kristine- olliesmom2014@gmail.com Wanted: Website Manager We have a new website, please check it out. It's still a work in progress but it's a big step up from the very basic one we have been using. If you have technical experience with building out websites and have been looking for a chance to help out, please let us know. body:
# [#]
Peter,

Every June, we celebrate and uplift LGBTQIA+ voices and experiences.

It’s been fifty-five years since the Stonewall riots, and though our nation has made great strides toward equality for the LGBTQIA+ community, much work remains to be done.

That’s why I’ve fought in Congress to extend civil rights protections against discrimination in education, employment, housing, and much more to LGBTQIA+ Americans.

Everyone deserves to live authentically and I’m proud of the work I’ve done to help make that a reality for all . But, we need to stand together to continue on the path toward equality.

So, Peter, please join me this month and every day in celebrating the LGBTQIA+ community in the 4th District and across our nation.

In solidarity,

Mike Thompson

clean_body: Unlike cicadas, whose presence is a force of nature, the political cicadas can be voted out. | Peter, Every 17 years, cicadas emerge from their long slumber, making a bunch of noise and creating a mess. This year, we’re not just talking about the insects. We’re talking about career politicians like Joe Biden and Sherrod Brown. Just like cicadas, these political hacks come out during election years, making loud promises while trying to cover up their previous failures with a ton of BS. Their biggest failure:the border. And no matter how hard they try to get us to forget – we won’t. Biden reversed 94 of Pres. Trump's executive orders that had secured the southern border, deported illegals, and gave border patrol the resources they needed to do their job. Now, after four long years and millions of illegals flooding into our country, he’s decided to sign a single, half-measure executive order that still allows a million illegals to come through the border. And Sherrod Brown has been Joe Biden’s biggest cheerleader in the Senate this whole time. Unlike cicadas, whose presence is a force of nature, the political cicadas can be voted out. We don’t have to endure their noise and chaos for another cycle. Don’t let the political cicadas win. For America, Bernie Moreno GOP Nominee for Senate, Ohio Meet Bernie Moreno: | Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18. Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America. In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First. Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has. | **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.
